title: AI Product Manager
job_description:
**Open Position: AI Product Manager**  
**Location: Malad (West), Mumbai**  
**Experience: 4+ years**  
**Qualification: Bachelor’s degree**   
**Only candidates based in Mumbai Suburban locations (Dahisar to Dadar) should apply for the Position.**

**You can also contact on: 9372974661 / 8928772622 / 7021155918**  
**We are working 6 days, i.e., from Monday to Saturday.**

**Role Summary**

Drive the roadmap and execution of an AI-powered LMS while managing the product development team. Focus on building scalable, user-friendly solutions that improve adoption and learning outcomes across industries.

**Job Description**

* Define and execute product roadmap for AI-driven LMS/LXP
* Manage and align the product development team for timely delivery
* Build AI-powered features such as personalized learning, recommendations, and chatbot interfaces
* Own end-to-end product lifecycle from requirements to release
* Work closely with enterprise clients to gather requirements and tailor solutions
* Drive product customization to suit different industries and use cases
* Prepare effort estimates and scope for new modules, enhancements, and customizations
* Improve user adoption, engagement, and overall experience
* Drive integrations with HRMS, content platforms, and collaboration tools
* Track product performance using data and analytics

**Requirements**

* 4+ years in Product Management (SaaS preferred)
* Experience in LMS, LXP, or HR Tech is a plus
* Strong understanding of AI/ML use cases in products
* Exposure to authoring tools and content creation workflows
* Experience in managing product or cross-functional development teams
* Experience in effort estimation, scoping, and requirement analysis
* Strong problem-solving and stakeholder management skills

**Good to Have**

* Experience with enterprise clients across industries
* Exposure to chatbot or conversational AI products
* Understanding of learning ecosystems and competency frameworks

**Key KPIs for This Role**

* Release Efficiency: % of features delivered on time vs planned roadmap
* Time to Market: Average time taken from feature finalization to market launch
* Wireframing Effectiveness: Time taken to convert requirements into approved wireframes
* AI Feature Impact: Usage and effectiveness of AI-driven features
* Customization Turnaround: Time taken to scope and deliver client-specific enhancements
* User Engagement: Improvement in completion rates, repeat usage, and session frequency
* Customer Feedback: Reduction in escalations and improvement in satisfaction scores
* Integration Success: Number and stability of integrations delivered
* Team Productivity: Sprint velocity, backlog closure rate, and development cycle time

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Group Product Manager : Animal Healthcare
job_description:
**Job Summary**

B.VSc/ M.VSc

We are looking for an experienced Brand Manager to help us build our brand and raise brand awareness. You’ll work across all levels and departments of our organization to find what makes us unique and communicate it to the world.

What does a Brand Manager do?

Brand Managers are the people who shape a company’s outward image. To do that, you’ll need to uncover consumer insights and deliver innovative marketing campaigns. We’ll turn to you to learn what can attract our customers and prospects and how we can improve customer experience.

If you’re creative, possess a strategic mind and have experience in implementing targeted brand campaigns, we’d like to meet you.

Ultimately, you’ll help us improve our company’s reputation and drive growth.

Responsibilities

* Analyze brand positioning and consumer insights
* Shape and communicate our vision and mission
* Translate brand elements into plans and go-to-market strategies
* Manage a team of marketing people working on brand initiatives
* Lead creative development to motivate the target audience to “take action”
* Establish performance specifications, cost and price parameters, market applications and sales estimates
* Measure and report performance of all marketing campaigns, and assess ROI and KPIs
* Monitor market trends, research consumer markets and competitors’ activities
* Oversee new and ongoing marketing and advertising activities
* Monitor product distribution and consumer reactions
* Devise innovative growth strategies
* Align the company around the brand’s direction, choices and tactics

Requirements and skills

* Proven working experience as Brand Manager or Associate Brand Manager
* Proven ability to develop brand and marketing strategies and communicate recommendations to executives
* Experience in identifying target audiences and devising effective campaigns
* Excellent understanding of the full marketing mix
* Strong analytical skills partnered with a creative mind
* Data-driven thinking and an affinity for numbers
* Outstanding communication skills
* Up-to-date with latest trends and marketing best practices
* Degree in marketing or a related field

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

job_description:
**Designation: Sr.Product Manager**

**Location: Gurugram**

**About the Role**
------------------

Are you a Product Manager with strong experience in POS, Retail Tech, Store Commerce, and Omnichannel? Do you enjoy solving complex retail problems, shaping product strategy, and building the future of intelligent store experiences?

**We're looking for a Senior Product Manager – POS to own the vision and roadmap for Cloud, Offline, Mobile & Omnichannel POS at our organsiation.**

**Department**

Product Management

  

**Experience**

7–11 Years

  

**Domain**

POS | Retail Tech | Omnichannel | Store Commerce

  

**Employment Type**

Full-Time

  

**What You'll Do**

* Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for Cloud, Offline, Mobile & Omnichannel POS
* Drive customer discovery and identify opportunities across the retail POS ecosystem
* Reimagine store journeys across Billing, Payments, Promotions, Loyalty, Returns & Inventory
* Build seamless experiences across Stores, E-commerce, Marketplaces & Customer Channels
* Partner with Engineering & Architecture on APIs, integrations, data flows, sync, security & performance
* Drive integrations across ERP, OMS, WMS, CRM, Payments, Tax & third-party retail platforms
* Lead product execution across Product, Design, Engineering, QA, Sales & Customer Success
* Identify and build AI-native opportunities across checkout, store operations, recommendations & associate assistance
* Define and track product metrics around adoption, customer satisfaction, retention, revenue & expansion
* Partner with Sales & Marketing on positioning, packaging, competitive differentiation & monetisation

  

**What We're Looking For**

* 7–11 years of Product Management experience
* Strong hands-on experience in POS, Store Commerce or Retail Technology
* Experience across Cloud POS, Offline POS, Mobile POS & Omnichannel
* Deep understanding of Billing, Payments, Promotions, Loyalty, Returns, Inventory & Taxation
* Experience building enterprise-grade products with high availability, offline resilience, integrations, security & scale
* Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, data flows, cloud architecture & synchronisation models
* Strong customer discovery, product strategy and commercial/ROI-driven prioritisation skills
* Strong AI-first mindset with hands-on exposure to modern AI tools and rapid prototyping

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**CapsLock** builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships.

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.

**﻿Role Overview**

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

**Responsibilities**

**﻿**

**﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
* Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

**2. User Needs & Automation**

* Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
* Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

**3. Product Development & Delivery**

* Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
* Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

**4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration**

* Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
* Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

**5. Experimentation & Optimization**

* Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
* Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

  
Requirements:
  

* 4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end.
* Proven track record of building internal or B2B tools for colleagues and driving high adoption.
* Skilled in KPI design, event taxonomy, dashboarding, and turning numbers into decisions.
* Active use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, n8n, custom scripts) to build prototypes and automate workflows. *(Examples will be requested).*
* Practical understanding of LLM limitations, probabilistic feature evaluation, and fallback logic.
* Comfortable running multiple workstreams at once and making confident calls on what to ship first.
* Strong track record of launching small, frequent releases rather than big-bang updates.
* Excellent written/verbal English—creates clear specs, explicit trade-offs, and transparent status updates.
* Experience collaborating effectively across global time zones.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience with paid acquisition platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok), rules engines, budget pacing, or creative testing workflows.
* Computer Science, Computer Engineering degree, or experience managing complex SaaS products with multi-platform API integrations.
* Hands-on experience with A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging, or staged rollout systems for spend-affecting logic.

**﻿Why do we deserve your attention?**

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

**Remote Work**

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

**Paid Time Off**

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

**Ongoing Learning**

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

**Home Office**

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

**Physical Well-Being**

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

**Unlimited Sick Days**

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

**Medical Coverage**

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

**Co-Working Space**

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

**Fun Stuff**

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

title: Associate Product Manager (B2B SaaS)
job_description:
**What You'll Do:**

* Own product areas end-to-end, from problem discovery and prioritization to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct customer discovery through interviews, workflow discussions, and feedback sessions with enterprise users and finance teams.
* Identify customer pain points, validate product hypotheses, and convert insights into scalable product opportunities.
* Build and maintain a data-driven product roadmap aligned with customer needs, business objectives, and market opportunities.
* Translate business and customer requirements into clear product specifications, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with UX/UI, Engineering, and QA teams to deliver products and features with the required quality and timelines.
* Track product success metrics such as adoption, Response rate, automation rates, workflow completion, and business impact.
* Analyse product usage, customer behaviour, and business data to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Explore opportunities to apply AI, automation, and data intelligence to complex enterprise finance workflows.
* Solve product challenges involving ERP integrations, business rules, data accuracy, and enterprise workflows.
* Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Support teams to understand market feedback and improve product adoption.
* Stay informed about industry developments, customer needs, and the competitive landscape to identify new product opportunities.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 3+ years of experience in Product Management, preferably in B2B SaaS, FinTech, or enterprise software.
* Experience owning products, features, or significant product areas from discovery through execution and launch.
* Strong problem-solving ability with a structured approach to breaking down complex business problems.
* Ability to understand customer needs and translate them into simple, scalable product solutions.
* Familiarity with Product documentation such as PRD’s, ticket creation, and related documents.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to support product decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong stakeholder management capabilities.
* Comfortable working closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum, JIRA, Figma, and modern product management practices.
* Experience working on 0-to-1 products or features is an advantage.
* Experience with AI-powered products, workflow automation, or enterprise integrations is an advantage.
* Familiarity with accounting, finance, or ERP processes is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* How would you rate your ability to analyse product/customer data and use insights to make product decisions? Rate on a scale of 1–10 (1 = No proficiency, 10 = Expert level)
* Are you comfortable with the ₹8–12 LPA compensation range?
* Have you independently owned a product, feature, or product area from problem discovery through launch and post-launch improvement?
* How would you rate your ability to translate complex business/customer requirements into product specs, user stories, workflows & acceptance criteria? (1–10) (1 = No proficiency, 10 = Expert level)
* What is your current CTC (in lakhs)?
* Notice period (in days)?
* Are you willing to travel to Andheri?

Experience:

* Product management: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

job_description:
**Job Title:** Technical Product Manager – BI & Analytics

**Experience:** 8+ Years

**Location:** Bengaluru

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager - BI Product, to own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of enterprise Business Intelligence (BI), Analytics, Semantic Metadata, and Metrics Management capabilities.

The role requires strong experience across Product Management, BI Platforms, Data Analytics, Semantic Layer, Metrics Layer, and Data Platforms. You will work closely with Engineering, Analytics, Data, Architecture, Governance, and Business teams to build a scalable and trusted enterprise analytics ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, backlog, and prioritization for enterprise BI and analytics platforms.
* Drive Semantic Layer, Semantic Models, Semantic Metadata, Metrics Layer, Metrics Management, and Metrics-as-a-Service capabilities.
* Establish a unified metrics layer / single source of truth across Tableau, Power BI, and downstream applications.
* Drive BI platform adoption, migration, consolidation, rationalization, self-service analytics, governed reporting, and embedded analytics.
* Work with Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Platform, Data Governance, and Architecture teams on enterprise BI solutions.
* Collaborate on modern data platforms including Snowflake, Databricks, Data Mesh, Cloud Data Platforms, and Enterprise Data Catalogs.
* Define and govern business metrics, dimensions, measures, data models, semantic models, and reporting standards.
* Identify and prioritize BI technical debt including legacy workbooks, deprecated extracts, redundant datasets, and duplicate data models.
* Lead product lifecycle activities including discovery, requirements, user research, delivery, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies and influence senior stakeholders across engineering, data, business, and governance teams.
* Lead Agile activities including Jira, Confluence, sprint planning, backlog management, product reviews, demos, and roadmap planning.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong Product Strategy, Product Roadmap, Stakeholder Management, Agile, and cross-functional leadership experience.
* Strong enterprise experience with Business Intelligence, BI Platforms, Data Analytics, and Analytics Products.
* Strong knowledge of Tableau and Power BI.
* Strong understanding of Semantic Layer, Semantic Metadata, Semantic Models, Metrics Layer, Metrics-as-a-Service, Metrics Management, and BI Governance.
* Experience with Metrics View, Cube, AtScale, dbt Metrics, or equivalent semantic/metrics technologies.
* Proven experience in BI migration, platform consolidation, rationalization, adoption, and self-service analytics.
* Understanding of data modeling, business metrics, dimensions, measures, reporting governance, and enterprise analytics architecture.
* Experience working with Snowflake, Databricks, Data Mesh, Cloud Data Platforms, or Data Governance environments.
* Excellent communication, influencing, analytical, and storytelling skills.

Pay: ₹4,000,000.00 - ₹5,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager
job_description:
Management Level

G

We are a growing B2B SaaS company dedicated to empowering businesses with innovative software solutions that streamline operations for corporate communication departments, especially mission critical investor relations and public relations teams.

  

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead product development for Ownership Intelligence business. This critical role will be responsible for executing feature development defined by our product roadmap, ensuring our solutions meet the evolving needs of our B2B customers, and ultimately contributing to the continued success and growth of the company. You will work with Product Management leadership to influence the product roadmap, develop requirements and direct Engineering teams to develop and release features that solve real-world problems for our clients.

  

**Location**
------------

This role will be based out of The Leela Office located on the 4th Floor, Airport Road, Kodihalli, Bangalore- 560008. Our expectation at this time, is that you would work from our office on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays with flexibility to work from home on Mondays and Fridays.

  

**Key Goal**
------------

To maximize product value through effective backlog management and delivery prioritization.

**Core Responsibility**
-----------------------

To critically evaluate information gathered from multiple sources, reconcile conflicts, decompose high-level information into details, and distinguish specific user requests from essential, common functional needs.

  

**Daily Activities**
--------------------

* Refine backlog and prioritize stories
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria
* Clarify requirements for developers
* Review sprint progress and remove blockers
* Test and validate completed features
* Work closely with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Product stakeholder, Product Marketing, and Customer Success teams to ensure seamless product delivery and go-to-market execution

**Your Skills and Competencies**
--------------------------------

* Education Required: Degree qualified in Computer Science, Business/Finance or related discipline, or equivalent work experience.

* Experience Required: 3+ years

* Strong analytical and product management skills required, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret customer business needs and translate them into application and operational requirements.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with a diverse group, managers, and subject matter experts.

* Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies and processes.

* Collaborate with developers and subject matter experts to establish the technical vision and analyze tradeoffs between usability and performance needs.

General understanding of the development and deployment of enterprise business software.  



**ABOUT NOTIFIED**  
  
**Notified, Your Story Begins Here**

We are Notified , the only technology partner dedicated to both investor relations and public relations professionals. We help our clients control and amplify the corporate narrative. Our fully integrated PR and IR platforms streamline every step from press release distribution, media targeting, and analytics to IR websites, earnings and investor events, and regulatory filings. Powered by GlobeNewswire, one of the largest and most trusted newswire distribution networks for over 30 years, we empower communicators to inform a better world.

  

Notified is an affiliate of Equiniti Group Limited (EQ), a fintech that connects the future of capital, communications, and governance — building trust and confidence in every market we serve.

**Why You Will Love Working Here**

EQ is recognized as a Top Employer in US, UK and India! Together we offer more than a job, we offer a place to grow. Through hands-on experience, real-world projects, and access to industry-leading tools, you’ll have what you need to build a meaningful career. You’ll join a diverse, global team united by innovation, collaboration, and a shared passion for what we do. With flexible work options, competitive pay, wellness benefits, and a people-first culture, we support your success - both at work and beyond.

  

**Come and join us — let’s grow together.**

We are committed to equality of opportunity for all staff and applications from individuals are encouraged regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships. Please note any offer of employment is subject to satisfactory pre-employment screening checks.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

### **Desired Skills & Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Product Management principles, Agile methodologies, and the product development lifecycle.
* Ability to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Experience managing and prioritizing product backlogs in a fast-paced Agile environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, technology teams, and cross-functional partners.
* Customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering valuable product outcomes.
* Experience supporting product delivery, testing, release readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Proficiency with Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar product management tools.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Finance, Engineering, or a related field preferred.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in financial services, wealth management, or digital product delivery.
* Familiarity with SAFe practices and Product Management frameworks.
* Experience leveraging AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot to improve productivity and product delivery.
* Strong Agile and Scrum methodology knowledge (SAFe)\
* Experience creating and refining User Stories
* Backlog management and prioritization skills
* Knowledge of product roadmaps and release planning
* Cross-functional collaboration with engineering, QA, and business teams
* Experience with JIRA/Azure DevOps
* Experience in executing Agile ceremonies- Standup, PI planning, Spring Planning, Sprint Demo etc.
* Requirements gathering and business analysis expertise
* Understanding of SDLC and Agile delivery metrics
* Facilitation of backlog refinement and sprint planning sessions

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Product Manager - Job Description and Responsibilities

Job Description

Client Services provides a world-class service experience to Visa's clients that begins with pre-sales and continues through onboarding, implementation of new products and services, issue resolution and service optimization.

The Client Services Digital and AI organization is dedicated to transforming and automating business processes across the end-to-end client service journey, making client and employee interactions with Visa straightforward, intuitive, and rewarding through the design, development, and delivery of enhanced digital experiences. As a member of the Digital and AI team, you will play a pivotal role in driving process improvement, automation, and digitization across Client Services, spanning onboarding, implementation, configuration, testing, licensing, service delivery, issue resolution, and optimization processes.

We are seeking a Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery of high-impact digital, AI, and automation products that improve processes across Client Services. This role will identify and prioritize opportunities, translate complex user and business needs into scalable product capabilities, guide technical solutioning, align cross-functional stakeholders, and drive measurable outcomes in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

The ideal candidate is a skilled product manager with deep product management experience, strong technical fluency, and demonstrated success applying rigorous critical thinking to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems. They have experience building and scaling AI-enabled products from discovery and prototyping through production, adoption, and continuous improvement. They will contribute to shaping the future of Client Services platforms and solutions, ensuring exceptional client and employee experiences, operational efficiency, responsible AI outcomes, resilient operations, and seamless integration with Visa systems.

Responsibilities

* Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for high-impact digital, AI, and automation products across a defined product area or process domain within Client Services, including discovery, user research, business-case development, requirements definition, prioritization, responsible AI and risk controls, experimentation, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration across business, product, technology, operations, design, data science, risk, legal, compliance, and regional teams; influence stakeholders and resolve trade-offs to maintain delivery momentum.
* Develop fluency in the payments ecosystem and Client Services capabilities, workflows, systems, data, controls, and operational dependencies to inform product strategy and execution across multiple process areas.
* Define measurable product outcomes and KPIs; monitor adoption, user experience, operational performance, model quality, risk, and value realization; and use data and feedback to guide prioritization and investment decisions.
* Apply rigorous critical thinking and systems thinking to ambiguous, complex, and multi-dependency Client Services challenges: frame problems, test assumptions, synthesize qualitative and quantitative evidence, evaluate alternatives and risks, make sound product decisions, and clearly articulate the rationale and expected business impact.
* Lead the development of AI-enabled products in partnership with engineering and data science, including use-case selection, rapid prototyping, data and model readiness, evaluation criteria, human oversight, privacy and security controls, production deployment, observability, and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Shape and deliver incident-management platform capabilities and workflow solutions that improve detection, intake, triage, escalation, collaboration, resolution, communications, reporting, and post-incident learning across Client Services.
* Communicate product strategy, investment rationale, delivery status, risks, dependencies, and performance insights to senior stakeholders and leadership, escalating to executive sponsors as needed.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

5 or more years of relevant product management experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or 3 or more years with an Advanced Degree (e.g., MBA, MS), including end-to-end ownership of complex digital, platform, automation, or AI-enabled products from discovery through launch and optimization.

* Required: Demonstrated critical-thinking, analytical judgment, and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently frame ambiguous business problems, challenge assumptions, evaluate qualitative and quantitative evidence, assess options and risks, and translate insights into product strategy, decisions, and clear requirements.
* Required: Demonstrated experience using AI technologies to build products, including identifying viable use cases, creating or directing prototypes, defining data and model requirements, establishing evaluation and success metrics, partnering with engineering and data science to productionize solutions, and applying responsible AI, privacy, security, and human-oversight practices. Experience with generative AI and/or agentic AI is required.
* Required: Experience using or building incident-management platforms and solutions, including defining workflows, product requirements, integrations, service-level measures, dashboards, and capabilities supporting incident intake, triage, escalation, resolution, communication, and post-incident improvement.

Preferred Qualifications:

7 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 4 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD

* Proven experience owning complex enterprise software, workflow, platform, automation, or AI products with multiple integrations, stakeholder groups, and operational dependencies.
* Strong technical acumen across enterprise systems, APIs, data architecture, cloud services, AI/ML concepts, model evaluation, and production monitoring, with the ability to make informed feasibility and trade-off decisions.
* Ability to explain complex business and technical concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way
* Strategic mindset with systems thinking, strong product judgment, and the ability to balance client value, operational impact, technical feasibility, risk, and investment trade-offs.
* Knowledge of payment systems (e.g. card networks, ACH) and banking
* Strong product execution and program leadership skills, with a record of delivering complex, multi-team, multi-region, and multi-dependency initiatives and managing risks, milestones, and value realization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to influence, negotiate, and drive results in complex, multi-dependency environments, ensuring that timelines are adhered to and any risks to the project are called out early.
* Strong customer-centric mindset
* Experience redesigning and digitizing end-to-end service or operational processes using journey mapping, process analysis, controls, and change-management practices.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications

* 5 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD.
* Experience in product management, product ownership, business process analysis, or sales operations.
* Experience applying Agile principles across design, development, testing, and product management.
* Experience developing software capabilities to support sales, service, or customer relationship management functions.
* Experience in managing and implementing complex projects directly or through supervision.
* Experience working in cross-functional teams to implement and assess operational impact of process changes.
* Experience soliciting and translating user feedback to inform product development.
* Experience driving product development with high velocity and quality.
* Experience in project management techniques, methodologies, and best practices such as Agile.
* Experience leading large Scrum teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD.
* Agile certifications such as CSM and CSPO, or their equivalent.
* Experience working with issuers and clients in the financial services industry or high-growth technology companies.
* Experience in product management in payments, common services, and identity and access management.
* Experience in API development using SOAP or REST, JSON, and XML.
* Experience in API security, security standards, data encryption, and HSMs.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams in global, highly matrixed organizations.
* Experience developing and executing product strategies that drive adoption and revenue growth.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco is seeking a Product Manager to join the Webex Customer Experience Solutions team. This role sets a clear product direction, turns customer and market evidence into an outcome-led roadmap, and leads delivery with engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and operations partners. The successful candidate will operate with high autonomy, make deliberate tradeoffs across customer value, quality, speed, and business impact, and communicate those decisions clearly to senior leaders and delivery teams.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  

* Set Product Direction and Roadmap
* Own the near-term vision and prioritized roadmap, aligned to broader business and product strategy.
* Translate customer problems, market shifts, technology opportunities, and operating constraints into clear product outcomes, requirements, and sequencing decisions.
* Develop business cases and success measures that connect feature investments to customer adoption, commercial value, reliability, and strategic goals.
* Lead Customer and Data Driven Decisions
* Build direct relationships with customers, partners, and internal field teams; synthesize feedback across research, support, usage, and market inputs.
* Validate early product concepts with customers and partners, then use the evidence to refine problem statements, product direction, and roadmap decisions.
* Monitor industry trends, customer expectations, and competitive signals to identify opportunities, risks, and needed adjustments to product strategy.
* Formulate the right business questions, use data to inform decisions, and connect project outcomes to meaningful metrics for the product area.
* Make and explain tradeoffs between customer needs, commercial priorities, product quality, and delivery capacity.
* Deliver High Quality Products
* Partner closely with engineering and design to define specifications, resolve technical and design tradeoffs, and deliver high-quality releases.
* Assess release readiness across functional, technical, customer, and business criteria; make clear decisions on whether a release meets the required bar.
* Manage the lifecycle from discovery through launch and iteration, including readiness with sales, marketing, customer success, support, and operations.
* Define and monitor adoption, workflow-efficiency, quality, and customer-impact measures after launch; use results to guide follow-on investment and iteration.
* Influence and Lead Across the Organization
* Align with Product stakeholders anticipate concerns, and build plans that balance their needs while maintaining product direction.
* Engage senior internal leaders and customer to shape positioning, gain buy-in, communicate roadmap choices, and resolve escalations.
* Mentor and support more junior PMs through informal coaching, stronger product artifacts, and practical delivery guidance.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 or more years of product management, product lifecycle management, solution architecture, or closely related experience in enterprise software, SaaS, communications, or customer experience products.
* Demonstrated ownership of a product roadmap or substantial product area, including prioritization, requirements, delivery, launch, and post-launch iteration.
* Experience translating customer needs and business goals into actionable product specifications, investment choices, and measurable outcomes.
* Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to use data, customer feedback, and operational evidence to make product decisions.
* Proven ability to influence engineering, design, sales, customer success, and operations partners in a matrixed environment without direct authority.
* Executive communication skills, including concise roadmap, tradeoff, and business-case presentations for internal and customer audiences.
* Experience defining product quality, adoption, commercial, reliability, and customer-success measures and using them to guide investment decisions.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with contact center, customer experience, communications, workflow automation, data and analytics, or AI-enabled enterprise software.
* Experience working with enterprise customers, strategic partners, and globally distributed product and engineering teams.
* Experience applying AI tools to enhance product insight, execution quality, and decision-making.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Group Product Manager II
job_description:
**(LOB - Cargoes Runner)**

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Translate high-level business requirements into detailed technical specs, and aggressively unblock

the engineer teams to execute fast

* Define a thoughtful, detailed, and executable rollout strategy for new features, releases, and

products.

* Write business cases, perform ROIs, and prioritize and write user stories; partner with product

development team to break things down and plan them into releases.

* Cultivate product positioning and benefit statements, partnering with the marketing and

communication team to create collateral that generates excitement and makes it easy for our

potential customers to adopt and understand the benefits.

* Measure the performance of product launches and iterate to success

Closing date for applications: 11/10/2026

Location Bangalore, India

Job typePermanent | Contract typeFull Time

#R-00286339

  

**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------

In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.

**Job description**
-------------------

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.

Join us as a Technical Product Manager

  
  

* You’ll be responsible for overseeing the lifecycle of technology products or major features that have a significant impact on the business
* This role will see you managing the product lifecycle, KPIs and risk
* You’ll gain valuable senior stakeholder exposure as well as the opportunity to hone your technical talents and leadership skills
* We're offering this role at vice president level
  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

In this key role, you’ll be providing technology specific guidance to key stakeholders along with owning strategic documentation relevant to the products. We’ll look to you to deliver a product roadmap that aligns with business objectives and technological advancements.

  
  

You’ll also be:

  
  

* Ensuring effective communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Leading the product development lifecycle from concept to delivery with a high-performing engineering team
* Making data-driven decisions that improve product performance and user satisfaction
* Providing regular reporting on product performance, development progress, and market trends
  

  

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------

  
  

We’re looking for a strategic thinker with a passion for technology and innovation. You’ll bring an understanding of technologies such as machine learning, hardware, software with experience in software engineering.

  
  

Furthermore, you’ll need:

  
  

* Strong exposure in identifying, prioritising, and shaping AI use cases that improve customer experience, colleague productivity, operational efficiency, and risk management
* Experience in translating business requirements into clear product features, user stories, technical requirements, and success metrics
* Partner with Engineering, Data, Operations, Risk, and Architecture teams to deliver scalable and resilient AI-enabled products
* Drive end-to-end product lifecycle management from ideation and prioritisation through delivery, adoption, and optimisation
* Ensure AI solutions comply with governance, security, regulatory, and data management requirements
* Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders and technology teams, ensuring strategic alignment and effective delivery

**Welcome to our Bangalore hub**
--------------------------------

Located at Taurus 4, Bagmane Constellation Business Park, our new office stands as a state-of-the-art hub for innovation and collaboration.

### **Key facts:**

* A 30 acre campus
* Space for 6,000 colleagues
* Opened in 2025

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Monitor platform health, availability, performance, capacity, usage, licensing, and workflow activity.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate platform changes and releases, including testing, UAT, upgrade validation, CAB/ECAB, production deployment, and post-release validation.**
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Support platform adoption and maintain SOPs, runbooks, configuration records, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and support procedures.**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Support other enterprise technology, analytics, automation, and AI platforms, including configuration, testing, APIs/integrations, access management, and operational support.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Minimum 4 years of experience in platform operations, systems administration, product operations, analytics/automation technologies, technology delivery, or a related role.**
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Hands-on experience with Alteryx Server and/or KNIME Server/Business Hub, including administration, server/platform configuration, maintenance, upgrades, deployment, scheduling, or production support, is strongly preferred.**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Understanding of Alteryx and/or KNIME workflows, execution, scheduling, connections, credentials, licensing, and enterprise deployment models.**
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience troubleshooting enterprise platforms using logs, telemetry, configuration analysis, and administration tools.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Working knowledge of enterprise identity, access, APIs and integration concepts including SSO, RBAC, Entra ID/Azure AD, REST APIs, HTTP, and JSON.**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience with enterprise change/release management and tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, or comparable platforms.**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills; exposure to SQL, Python, PowerShell, Alteryx/KNIME certifications, or cloud technologies is preferred.**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

title: Product Manager
job_description:
Product Manager – AI-Native Strategy Execution

Location - Bangalore

About GravityONE

**GravityONE** is an AI-native technology company building the next generation of products for strategy, decision-making and execution. We work at the intersection of **AI, strategy, data and enterprise workflows**, helping organisations move beyond traditional dashboards and disconnected tools towards intelligent systems that can help leaders and teams plan, decide, coordinate and act.

Our products are designed for complex environments where strategy needs to translate into measurable outcomes—with the right context, governance, intelligence and accountability built into the way organisations operate.

One of our core products, **StrategyDotZero**, is building an AI-native strategy-execution platform for governments and enterprises. We help executives, Strategy Offices, PMOs and transformation teams connect strategy, planning, performance, portfolios and delivery into one intelligence-enabled operating environment.

Our ambition is to move beyond dashboards and workflow tools—to create governed digital experts and agentic workflows that help organisations plan, decide, coordinate and act with greater confidence.

The Role

We are seeking an exceptional, hands-on **Product Manager** to turn this vision into a focused, market-ready product.

You will sit at the intersection of **strategy, design, data, analytics and AI**: shaping product direction, rapidly testing concepts with customers, and working closely with engineering, AI and growth teams to turn complex problems into elegant, adoptable capabilities.

This is a build-stage role for someone who enjoys ambiguity, moves quickly and can balance bold product thinking with disciplined execution. We are particularly interested in candidates who bring the **structured problem-solving and transformation mindset of top-tier consulting**, combined with strong product judgement and the ability to build and ship.

What you will do

* Translate the StrategyDotZero vision into clear product strategy, customer journeys, MVPs, roadmaps and fortnightly release plans.
* Shape AI-native experiences across strategy, planning, portfolio management, PMO, performance, benefits, risk and executive decision support.
* Define how agentic workflows, LLM-enabled generation, analytics, enterprise data and human approval work together in practical product experiences.
* Rapidly create wireframes, clickable prototypes, concept demonstrations and lightweight proof-of-value solutions to test ideas with users before building at scale.
* Lead product discovery with executives, PMO leaders, strategy teams and delivery practitioners; identify high-value problems, validate assumptions and translate insight into product decisions.
* Write high-quality user stories, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, workflow logic and release documentation that engineering teams can build with confidence.
* Work closely with engineers and AI specialists to define fit-for-purpose agent behaviours, inputs, outputs, controls, evaluation criteria and user feedback loops.
* Ensure every capability is enterprise-ready: role-based access, source evidence, data quality, confidence indicators, auditability and human approval for material decisions or changes.
* Prioritise the roadmap using customer value, strategic differentiation, delivery effort, technical dependencies and commercial potential.
* Run agile planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, release readiness and post-release learning with discipline and pace.
* Partner with growth and customer teams to shape demos, value narratives, pilots, customer feedback loops and product-market fit.

What we are looking for

* **5+ years of experience** in product management, product design, strategy/technology consulting or a related product-building role.
* **MBA from a reputed institution**, preferably with a focus on strategy, technology, operations or a related discipline.
* **Prior experience with a Big 4 consulting firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY or KPMG) or a strong strategy/management consulting environment is highly preferred.** We value candidates who have developed strong structured problem-solving, executive communication, business transformation and stakeholder management skills and can apply that thinking to product development.
* Experience building **B2B, enterprise SaaS, workflow, analytics, data or AI-enabled products**—ideally in complex, regulated or multi-stakeholder environments.
* Strong understanding of strategy execution, planning, PMO, portfolio management, transformation, performance or operational governance; deep expertise in every domain is not required, but curiosity and rapid learning are.
* Practical familiarity with AI product patterns: **LLMs, RAG, structured outputs, agentic workflows, enterprise data context, human-in-the-loop design, evaluation and feedback loops.**
* Strong UX and design judgement, with the ability to use tools such as **Figma and AI-assisted prototyping tools** to make concepts tangible quickly.
* Comfortable working with data, dashboards, integrations, APIs and enterprise workflow concepts; able to speak credibly with engineers without needing to be a full-time developer.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to move comfortably between a **client executive, product designer, engineer and delivery practitioner.**
* A strong bias toward action: able to frame a problem, form a hypothesis, prototype, test, learn and improve within days—not months.
* Comfortable in a lean, high-growth environment where ownership is broad, priorities evolve and quality still matters.

What success looks like

* A focused, differentiated product roadmap that converts the StrategyDotZero vision into commercially valuable releases.
* Fast, evidence-led product discovery with customers and a regular cadence of validated prototypes and shipped capabilities.
* Clear and reusable product patterns for enterprise AI: governed agents, source-grounded outputs, human approvals and actionable workflows.
* Strong alignment between product, engineering, AI, growth and client teams.
* A platform that customers experience not as another PMO tool, but as an **intelligence layer that improves the quality and speed of strategy execution.**
* A product leader who brings together **consulting rigour, product thinking, AI fluency and execution discipline** to turn complex enterprise problems into simple, valuable products.

If you think this

If you think this role is for you, we’d love to hear from you.

**Send your profile to:** ashwini.vagadia@gravityone.ai

You will sit at the intersection of **strategy, design, data, analytics and AI**: shaping product direction, rapidly testing concepts with customers, and working closely with engineering, AI and growth teams to turn complex problems into elegant, adoptable capabilities.

This is a build-stage role for someone who enjoys ambiguity, moves quickly and can balance bold product thinking with disciplined execution. We are particularly interested in candidates who bring the **structured problem-solving and transformation mindset of top-tier consulting**, combined with strong product judgement and the ability to build and ship.

What you will do

* Translate the StrategyDotZero vision into clear product strategy, customer journeys, MVPs, roadmaps and fortnightly release plans.
* Shape AI-native experiences across strategy, planning, portfolio management, PMO, performance, benefits, risk and executive decision support.
* Define how agentic workflows, LLM-enabled generation, analytics, enterprise data and human approval work together in practical product experiences.
* Rapidly create wireframes, clickable prototypes, concept demonstrations and lightweight proof-of-value solutions to test ideas with users before building at scale.
* Lead product discovery with executives, PMO leaders, strategy teams and delivery practitioners; identify high-value problems, validate assumptions and translate insight into product decisions.
* Write high-quality user stories, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, workflow logic and release documentation that engineering teams can build with confidence.
* Work closely with engineers and AI specialists to define fit-for-purpose agent behaviours, inputs, outputs, controls, evaluation criteria and user feedback loops.
* Ensure every capability is enterprise-ready: role-based access, source evidence, data quality, confidence indicators, auditability and human approval for material decisions or changes.
* Prioritise the roadmap using customer value, strategic differentiation, delivery effort, technical dependencies and commercial potential.
* Run agile planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, release readiness and post-release learning with discipline and pace.
* Partner with growth and customer teams to shape demos, value narratives, pilots, customer feedback loops and product-market fit.

What we are looking for

* **5+ years of experience** in product management, product design, strategy/technology consulting or a related product-building role.
* **MBA from a reputed institution**, preferably with a focus on strategy, technology, operations or a related discipline.
* **Prior experience with a Big 4 consulting firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY or KPMG) or a strong strategy/management consulting environment is highly preferred.** We value candidates who have developed strong structured problem-solving, executive communication, business transformation and stakeholder management skills and can apply that thinking to product development.
* Experience building **B2B, enterprise SaaS, workflow, analytics, data or AI-enabled products**—ideally in complex, regulated or multi-stakeholder environments.
* Strong understanding of strategy execution, planning, PMO, portfolio management, transformation, performance or operational governance; deep expertise in every domain is not required, but curiosity and rapid learning are.
* Practical familiarity with AI product patterns: **LLMs, RAG, structured outputs, agentic workflows, enterprise data context, human-in-the-loop design, evaluation and feedback loops.**
* Strong UX and design judgement, with the ability to use tools such as **Figma and AI-assisted prototyping tools** to make concepts tangible quickly.
* Comfortable working with data, dashboards, integrations, APIs and enterprise workflow concepts; able to speak credibly with engineers without needing to be a full-time developer.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to move comfortably between a **client executive, product designer, engineer and delivery practitioner.**
* A strong bias toward action: able to frame a problem, form a hypothesis, prototype, test, learn and improve within days—not months.
* Comfortable in a lean, high-growth environment where ownership is broad, priorities evolve and quality still matters.

What success looks like

* A focused, differentiated product roadmap that converts the StrategyDotZero vision into commercially valuable releases.
* Fast, evidence-led product discovery with customers and a regular cadence of validated prototypes and shipped capabilities.
* Clear and reusable product patterns for enterprise AI: governed agents, source-grounded outputs, human approvals and actionable workflows.
* Strong alignment between product, engineering, AI, growth and client teams.
* A platform that customers experience not as another PMO tool, but as an **intelligence layer that improves the quality and speed of strategy execution.**
* A product leader who brings together **consulting rigour, product thinking, AI fluency and execution discipline** to turn complex enterprise problems into simple, valuable products.

If you think this

If you think this role is for you, we’d love to hear from you.

**Send your profile to:** ashwini.vagadia@gravityone.ai

job_description:
### **Who We Are**

Simpplr is the AI-powered intranet for unifying the digital workplace. It brings people, trusted knowledge, apps, and agents into a coherent digital experience. Powered by a proprietary EX Knowledge Graph, Simpplr synthesizes signals and context across connected systems to deliver personalized information and actions. The platform serves as a digital hub supporting communications, engagement, employee services, and work. With low-code extensibility and enterprise-grade security and governance, Simpplr enables confident operation at scale. More than 1,000 organizations — including AAA, the NHS, Penske, and Moderna — trust Simpplr to keep their workforce informed, aligned, and productive. Learn more at simpplr.com.

**Who we are**

Simpplr builds AI-powered intranet for modern enterprises. Our platform unifies employee engagement, enablement, and services, leveraging state-of-the-art AI models to deliver a seamless, cohesive, and personalized employee experience for everyone — wherever and however they work.

Our mission is to transform the work experience for billions of people across the world. Because we believe that when work is good, life is better.™

Trusted by more than 1,000 leading brands, including DocuSign, Penske, Splunk, Nutanix, Okta, Eurostar, and SoFi, our customers are achieving measurable improvements in employee engagement, productivity, and accelerated business performance.

Simpplr is headquartered in Silicon Valley, CA with offices in the UK, Canada, and India, and is backed by Sapphire Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, Salesforce Ventures, and Tola Capital. Learn more at simpplr.com.

  

**The role**

We have more ideas than we can build. Your job is to figure out which ones are real, and turn the survivors into a product specification sharp enough for engineering to build from.

You won't be generating ideas!! You'll be the person who decides which ones deserve investment — through live customer conversations, rigorous market sizing, and a written case that leadership can act on. Some of what you look at should die. Killing an idea well is as valuable here as championing one !!

**What you'll do**

* Take a rough concept and design the fastest honest test of whether there's a real need behind it
* Run customer and prospect interviews; separate what people said from what you concluded
* Size the opportunity — TAM/SAM, pricing, unit economics — and be clear about which assumptions the number actually rests on
* Write the recommendation memo: build, don't build, or build something narrower. Own the call.
* Turn a validated concept into a PRD — problem, scope, what's in the first version and what isn't
* Work with engineering leads on feasibility early enough that it changes the spec, not after

**What we're looking for**

* MBA from IIM A/B/C/L/I/K or equivalent.
* Exceptional structured writing. Your memos are the product of this role.
* High Comfort with numbers: financial modeling in Excel/Sheets, basic SQL, product analytics
* Can hold a real conversation with a senior Global executive based in developed markets (or a frustrated customer without a script !!)
* Already using AI tools in how you work, not just aware of them

**What you get**

Direct access to CXOs on a daily basis, real ownership of investment recommendations, and a short path between your analysis and what actually gets built.

### **Your Voice, Unfiltered:**

We value the real you. To ensure a fair and authentic experience for everyone, we ask that you do not use AI tools (such as real-time answer generators, transcription apps, or note-taking bots) during your interview

Our process is designed to hear your unique story, thought process, and lived experience in real-time. Use of unauthorized AI tools may result in disqualification, as we want to ensure every candidate is evaluated on their own individual merits. We’re excited to meet the person behind the resume!

If you need assistive technology or AI tools for accessibility (e.g., live captioning), please notify your recruiter in advance. We are committed to providing an inclusive interview experience.

### **Simpplr’s Hub-Hybrid-Remote Model:**

At Simpplr we believe that when work is good, life is better and that belief guides all we do. Including how we approach our flexible work model. Simpplr operates with a Hub-Hybrid-Remote model. This model is role-based with exceptions and provides employees with the flexibility that many have told us they want.

* **Hub -** **100% work from Simpplr office.** Role requires Simpplifier to be in the office full-time.
* **Hybrid -** **Hybrid work from home and office.** Role dictates the ability to work from home, plus benefit from in-person collaboration on a regular basis.
* **Remote - 100% remote.** Role can be done anywhere within your country of hire, as long as the requirements of the role are met.

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**About SatSure**
-----------------

SatSure is a global Earth intelligence company headquartered in India. Founded in 2017, SatSure operates across the Earth observation data value chain—from payload infrastructure and foundational AI technologies to decision intelligence solutions. We work with private companies and government bodies across agriculture, agri-banking, forestry, critical infrastructure, and aviation.

Through our subsidiary KaleidEO, we are building multispectral payloads for high-definition satellite imagery with edge computing capabilities, supporting sovereign and commercial applications.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager with strong agriculture domain knowledge and hands-on experience in product discovery, solutioning, and zero-to-one product development.

Your primary focus will be identifying unmet customer needs, shaping scalable solutions, and taking new products from discovery through launch. You will use AI-enabled workflows to accelerate development and build reusable capabilities that support future products and use cases. You will also partner with commercial teams to support adoption and expansion within existing accounts.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1.** **Product Discovery**

* Own deep, continuous discovery informed by market shifts, direct customer engagement and feedback, internal stakeholder insights, and the competitive landscape.
* Understand customer workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes through structured interviews, field visits, and usage analysis.
* Identify recurring problems and distinguish individual customer requests from broader product opportunities.
* Test assumptions and validate customer problems and solution concepts through research, prototypes, and targeted experiments.

### **2.** **Solutioning and Product Strategy**

* Translate complex agriculture problems into practical, scalable solutions with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and commercial teams.
* Assess opportunities for customer value, commercial viability, technical feasibility, and data availability.
* Define product strategy and roadmaps with the VP of Product, prioritizing validated opportunities aligned with business goals.
* Translate opportunities into clear requirements, solution concepts, and measurable success criteria.

### **3.** **Zero-to-One Product Development**

* Lead new products from validated problems through prototyping, development, testing, and launch.
* Align cross-functional teams on scope, priorities, dependencies, and delivery milestones.
* Use AI-enabled research, synthesis, prototyping, and development workflows to shorten the journey from discovery to launch.
* Build reusable data, analytics, and product capabilities that reduce development effort across new products and use cases.
* Ensure releases meet agreed customer, usability, and quality requirements, and incorporate early customer feedback into subsequent iterations.

### **4.** **Product Adoption and Account Expansion**

* Partner with Sales and Customer Success to support adoption and identify new use cases within existing accounts.
* Track product usage, customer outcomes, and performance to guide improvements and further discovery.
* Support customer-facing teams with product demonstrations, positioning, and release guidance.

**Must-Have Experience and Skills**
-----------------------------------

* **Agriculture domain expertise:** Strong understanding of customer workflows, industry challenges, and business needs.
* **Zero-to-one product development and solutioning:** Hands-on experience identifying and validating customer problems, shaping scalable solutions with technical and commercial teams, and taking new products through development and launch.
* **Cross-functional delivery:** Experience managing complex product releases in a startup environment using agile practices.
* **Analytical and commercial judgment:** Ability to assess data, customer value, business impact, and product trade-offs.
* **Communication:** Ability to clearly articulate problems, solutions, and priorities and align teams and senior stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 6 or more years of product management experience.
* B.Tech and MBA from a Tier 1 institution.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Understanding of remote sensing and geospatial technologies.
* People management experience.

**Benefits**
------------

* Opportunity to build data products at the intersection of agriculture, AI, and space technology.
* A flat organizational structure grounded in empathy, problem-solving, integrity, customer focus, and ownership.
* Learning and skill development allowances, broadband and remote work support.
* Medical insurance for you and your family, including unlimited online doctor consultations.
* Access to mental health experts for you and your family.
* Comprehensive leave policy, including casual, paid, marriage, and bereavement leave.

**Interview Process**
---------------------

* Introductory call.
* Interview rounds, typically three to four.
* Culture and HR discussion.
