**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

As the Principal Product Manager for Fulfillment Servicing products, you will be responsible for the end-to-end product lifecycle management, from conception to launch and beyond. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, marketing, billing, Sales, and customer support to define the product strategy, prioritization, and roadmap.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

* Drive product vision & strategy, business requirements documentation and analysis
* Ensure alignment to technology strategy throughout product life cycle
* Manage the product profit & loss (P&L)
* Manage product area’s investment decisions, scope, roadmap, priorities
* Understand/monitor product's competitive and market landscape
* Conduct/attend visits, customer touch-bases, focus groups, conferences
* Support sales engineering and commercial/delivery/care teams
* Be the product's subject-matter expert (SME) inside scrum teams
* Contribute to scrum team stories, define acceptance criteria
* Create, refine, prioritize scrum team's backlog, and accept work
* Attend scrum ceremonies and provide guidance to scrum teams
* Provide product expertise and prioritization of maintenance issues
* Conduct demos (internal or external, as needed)
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering teams to ensure timely and quality delivery of features, managing trade-offs between time, scope, and resources.
* Performance Monitoring: Establish metrics and KPIs to monitor the success of the product capabilities, analyze data to make informed decisions, and continuously improve product performance.
Communication: Effectively communicate product updates and roadmap changes to internal & external stakeholders.  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field and/or relevant work experience
* Previous experience as a Product Manager or similar role in software development, specifically with GUI design and user interfaces.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate ideas clearly and influence cross-functional teams.
* Analytical mindset with proficiency in data-driven decision making.
Experience with Agile methodologies and project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Salesforce, etc).  

Work arrangement

3 chosen days from the office in a week, or Remote  



We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

job_description:
**About the role**

**Work Level Description**

I balance exceptional delivery for customers on what matters, engaging teams and colleagues, with the needs of the business. I am an expert and often the first layer of management of people or projects.

**Job Summary**

The Product Manager - Core HR, Roles & Access is a key role within the colleague transformation programme. You will be responsible for delivering a best‑in‑class end‑user experience across Core HR data, roles, and access management within Tesco’s Work & Pay and associated platforms.

You will own a large, business‑critical product domain with multiple internal and external stakeholders. You will define the product vision, shape the roadmap, and lead delivery from discovery through to implementation and optimisation. You will apply strong product management practices, champion user‑centric design, and drive data‑led decision‑making to continuously improve product performance

**You will be responsible for**

**You Will Be Responsible For**

**Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmap**

* Creating and driving forward the unified product vision, strategy and roadmap for Core HR and Roles & Access.
* Ensuring alignment with programme objectives, business priorities, and colleague experience outcomes.
* Validating requirements for future waves and releases to ensure long‑term scalability and compliance.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Discovery**

* Identifying stakeholder groups and building strong relationships to understand their Jobs To Be Done.
* Understanding user personas, customer journeys and pain points across both product areas.
* Discovering, managing and prioritising requirements using epics, user stories, personas and acceptance criteria.

**Product Delivery & Backlog Ownership**

* Creating, maintaining and owning the product backlog for Core HR and Roles & Access.
* Applying strong prioritisation techniques to maximise business value with minimal effort.
* Working with programme and technology teams to progress backlog items through Tesco Flow methodology, sprint planning and release cycles.
* Supporting the enduring model to transition delivered processes into BAU.

**Product Performance & Compliance**

* Delivering to agreed KPIs and being accountable for product performance, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Driving experiments, testing hypotheses and creating MVPs to inform data‑driven decisions.
* Ensuring compliance with information security, data protection and access governance standards.
* Prioritising, coordinating and communicating the resolution of live product issues independently.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Providing support, coaching and guidance to junior Product Managers and peers.
* Demonstrating product features confidently to varied audiences across Tesco.
* Collaborating with colleagues, business stakeholders, suppliers and third parties to ensure successful delivery.

**Key People and Teams You Work With**

* Members of the product team
* Users of the product and business stakeholders
* Colleagues across Tesco
* Suppliers and third‑party partners

**People, Budgets and Other Resources You Are Accountable For**

* Line management responsibility for an Associate Product Manager.

 **You will need**

**Skills Relevant for the Job**

* A methodical and analytical approach with strong problem‑solving skills.
* Excellent prioritisation skills to refine and groom the backlog effectively.
* Ability and appetite to learn new product domains quickly.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong presentation and persuasion skills.
* A collaborative team player who works effectively across functions.

**Experience Relevant for the Job**

* Prior experience with leading HCM cloud solutions such as Oracle HCM Cloud (Fusion) and Zellis HCM Cloud.
* Strong understanding of Core HR, roles, access management and associated data structures.
* Good understanding of technologies and functionalities in Core HR / Security for designing system integrations.
* Understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle and how software products are built.
* Experience in developing or managing a product (desirable).
* Strong knowledge of tools and techniques for backlog prioritisation, dependency management and data‑driven insights.
* Broad understanding of technologies relevant to product management.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, data mapping experience and ability to manage high‑volume data.
* Requirements gathering and prioritisation experience is essential.

**Whats in it for you?**  

At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day.

title: Lead Product Manager - 10-15 years
job_description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

Job Summary

We are hiring a Lead Product Manager (P5) to lead strategy and execution for next-generation products in Nielsen's Ad Intel portfolio. This is a senior, high-visibility role responsible for incubating and scaling products that give clients visibility into competitive advertising activity, spend, creative strategy, and cross-media/cross-platform ad performance. You will provide expertise in solving unique, complex problems with broad impact on the business, contribute to strategy development, and lead teams and projects that guide cross-functional groups to discover, validate, build, and launch differentiated solutions across the advertising landscape.

Roles and Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Innovation

* Define the multi-year product strategy for Nielsen's Ad Intel suite, spanning traditional (TV, print, radio, outdoor) and digital/social ad tracking.
* Identify whitespace and monetization opportunities across creative intelligence, spend estimation, competitive benchmarking, and cross-media ad exposure measurement.
* Partner with data science, measurement, and engineering teams to productize proprietary ad detection, classification, and spend-modeling capabilities.

Customer Discovery & Market Fit

* Lead structured customer discovery with brands, agencies, media owners, and platform partners to surface unmet needs in competitive ad intelligence.
* Validate product-market fit through alpha/beta programs and signal-based experimentation across ad formats and channels.
* Represent the voice of the market in prioritization and roadmap decisions, balancing client demand with technical and data feasibility.

Execution Leadership

* Drive rapid incubation, validation, and scaling of new Ad Intel capabilities from 0-to-1 through to enterprise-grade deployment.
* Collaborate with engineering, data science, UX, commercial, and external data partners to deliver differentiated, defensible products.
* Set clear OKRs and lead outcome-based execution from MVP through scaled rollout, owning tradeoffs across scope, data quality, and timeline.

Go-to-Market & Partner Strategy

* Partner with GTM, partnerships, and commercial teams to shape pricing, packaging, and positioning for Ad Intel products.
* Engage strategic data and platform partners (e.g., ad exchanges, creative repositories, social platforms, clean rooms) to expand coverage and data depth.
* Support sales enablement and client-facing teams with product narratives, competitive positioning, and value articulation.

 **Qualifications**

* Qualifications: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree or specialized certifications preferred.
* Typical Experience: 10- 15 years of experience with a strong reputation as an expert in advertising intelligence, programmatic media, or related product domains.
* Skills: Top-tier expertise, leadership in innovation, and strategic project management. Proven ability to shape strategies and lead complex initiatives.
* Strong understanding of the advertising ecosystem — media buying, creative strategy, competitive intelligence, and cross-platform ad measurement.
* Track record of launching 0-to-1 products and scaling innovation within a matrixed, data-driven organization.
* Strong analytical and technical fluency — comfortable working with large-scale data pipelines, APIs, classification/ML models, and measurement frameworks.
* Skilled at stakeholder management and cross-functional influence across engineering, data science, commercial, and executive stakeholders.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

**About the Role**

As the LPM for CoreHRMS, you will own the strategic charter across CoreHRMS, Time & Attendance, and Compliance pods. This is not just about solving module-level problems but shaping how employee lifecycle, policies, and compliance come together into a unified, enterprise-ready platform. You’ll define multi-quarter roadmaps, orchestrate pods, and ensure CoreHRMS is the anchor product for Keka’s enterprise growth in India and GCC.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Multi-Pod Orchestration: Align CoreHRMS, T&A, and Compliance into a unified enterprise

roadmap.

* Enterprise Lifecycle Ownership: Automate exit, probation, letters, policy mapping, and

headcount planning.

* Strategic Bets: Scope, prioritize, justify high-leverage enterprise features.
* Cross-Pod Governance: Set standards for discovery, delivery, and customer outcome

measurement.

* Customer-Led Roadmaps: Synthesize HR/CHRO insights into cluster-level JTBD and

outcomes.

* Revenue Alignment: Link CoreHRMS roadmap directly to enterprise ARR uplift and NRR

improvement.

**What Makes This Role Unique**

* Anchor role for enterprise expansion (India Upmarket + GCC).
* High visibility with CPO, CEO, and GTM leadership.
* Scope to scale into Director of Product leading multiple clusters.
* Ownership of multi-quarter, cross-pod strategy, not just features.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* 7–10 yrs PM experience; at least 3+ yrs in enterprise-grade HR/ERP/Platform products.
* Proven success in multi-pod orchestration and customer-led roadmaps.
* Strong systems thinker with CoreHR/HRMS expertise.
* Confident in executive storytelling and influencing GTM & leadership.
* Bonus: Experience in India Upmarket HR, GCC compliance, or US onboarding.

**What Keka Offers**

- Lead the CoreHRMS enterprise charter in a company scaling from 10 -> 100.

* High-leverage role impacting adoption, retention, and global readiness.
* Access to C-suite, strategic decision forums, and enterprise customers.
* Autonomy to define Keka’s CoreHRMS evolution into a global platform

title: Product Manager
job_description:
About RapidClaims

RapidClaims is a leader in AI-driven revenue cycle management, transforming medical coding and revenue operations with cutting-edge technology.

The company has raised $11 million in total funding from top investors, including Accel and Together Fund.

Join us as we scale a cloud-native platform that runs transformer-based Large Language Models rigorously fine-tuned on millions of clinical notes and claims every month. You’ll engineer autonomous coding pipelines that parse ICD-10-CM, CPT® and HCPCS at lightning speed, deliver reimbursement insights with sub-second latency and >99 %

accuracy, and tackle the deep-domain challenges that make clinical AI one of the hardest—and most rewarding—problems in tech.

Product Manager - Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager with 4+ years of proven expertise to drive innovation in healthcare technology and revenue cycle management (RCM). In this role, you will be responsible for leading the discovery, design, and delivery of products that improve medical coding, claims processing, and overall healthcare efficiency. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to shape the roadmap and deliver products that make a measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

● Define and own product features and requirements across the healthcare/RCM product suite.

● Conduct customer research, market analysis, and competitor benchmarking to identify opportunities for innovation.

● Collaborate with engineering, design, and data science teams to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions.

● Act as product owner in Agile teams: manage backlogs, prioritize sprints, and ensure timely execution.

● Partner with sales, operations, and customer success to support go-to-market initiatives and adoption.

● Track and analyze product KPIs (adoption, retention, claim denial rates, cost savings) and continuously optimize for impact.

● Represent the voice of the customer (hospitals, physician groups, payers) and translate feedback into actionable product improvements.

● Stay up to date with industry trends in health-tech, RCM, AI/LLMs, and regulatory requirements.

Requirements

● Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field; MBA

preferred.

● 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in healthcare technology, SaaS,

or fintech.

● Strong understanding of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), medical coding, claims

workflows, or healthcare operations is highly desirable.

● Proven success in delivering products from concept to launch, managing

cross-functional teams.

● Data-driven mindset with experience using analytics tools (SQL, Python, BI tools).

● Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and product management tools (Jira,

Trello, Asana).

● Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

● Exposure to AI/ML or LLM-based solutions in healthcare or technology.

● Prior work in startups, consulting, or high-growth environments.

● Ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

Why Join Us?

● Opportunity to solve some of the most pressing challenges in healthcare and revenue

cycle management.

● Work on cutting-edge AI-powered solutions that directly impact hospitals, providers,

and patients.

● Collaborative and fast-paced startup culture with strong growth opportunities.

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Are you willing to work from Koramangala , Bangalore office
* What is your current CTC
* What is your expected CTC
* What is your notice period to join
* How many years of product management experience

Work Location: In person

title: AI Product Manager
job_description:
**About Vyapar:**

Vyapar is a business accounting software that simplifies the process of managing a business for millions of Indian MSMEs. The software allows users to create business transactions, share them with their customers, manage their inventory, keep track of their receivable / payable and manage end to end taxation.

Vyapar is used by almost every type of businesses in India, be it retailers, distributors, wholesalers, manufacturers or service professionals. The horizontal approach towards building Vyapar allows every business to fit it into our use case and manage it efficiently. From a small garage service center to multi-outlet grocery store, Vyapar is built for and used by almost the entire breadth of business types in India. As far as numbers go, Vyapar has been installed by **almost 1 crore businessmen** across the country.

**Role Summary:**

To craft an intuitive, world-class user experience for the business community, we are looking for supercharged product manager who will help build new products and make the current product 10x better.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Define product vision, roadmap, and strategy for AI-powered features.
* Identify business problems and opportunities where AI can add value.
* Work with customers and internal teams to understand requirements and user needs.
* Create **PRDs, user flows, and wireframes**.
* Work closely with **Engineering, Data Science, ML, and Design teams** to build and launch AI features.
* Track product performance, user adoption, and key metrics.
* Define KPIs and success metrics for AI products.
* Continuously improve products based on customer feedback and data.
* Work with Sales and Support teams to drive product adoption.

**Desired Skills and Requirements:**

* **2–4 years of AI Product Management experience**,
* Experience working on **AI/ML or GenAI products**.
* Good understanding of **LLMs, Generative AI, NLP, RAG, and AI/ML concepts**.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with **PRDs, wireframing, product metrics, and experimentation**.
* Strong product understanding and product sense.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work closely with Engineering and Data Science teams.
* Strong ownership and execution skills..

**Experience:**

  

* Previous tech-product experience (preferably 2-4 years)

**Education:**

  

* Engineering or Management degree (preferably from a top tier institute IITs, IIMs, NITs, BITS etc.)

From a small garage service center to multi-outlet grocery store, Vyapar is built for and used by almost the entire breadth of business types in India. As far as numbers go, Vyapar has been installed by **almost 1 crore businessmen** across the country.

**Role Summary:**

To craft an intuitive, world-class user experience for the business community, we are looking for supercharged product manager who will help build new products and make the current product 10x better.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Define product vision, roadmap, and strategy for AI-powered features.
* Identify business problems and opportunities where AI can add value.
* Work with customers and internal teams to understand requirements and user needs.
* Create **PRDs, user flows, and wireframes**.
* Work closely with **Engineering, Data Science, ML, and Design teams** to build and launch AI features.
* Track product performance, user adoption, and key metrics.
* Define KPIs and success metrics for AI products.
* Continuously improve products based on customer feedback and data.
* Work with Sales and Support teams to drive product adoption.

**Desired Skills and Requirements:**

* **2–4 years of AI Product Management experience**,
* Experience working on **AI/ML or GenAI products**.
* Good understanding of **LLMs, Generative AI, NLP, RAG, and AI/ML concepts**.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with **PRDs, wireframing, product metrics, and experimentation**.
* Strong product understanding and product sense.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work closely with Engineering and Data Science teams.
* Strong ownership and execution skills..

**Experience:**

  

* Previous tech-product experience (preferably 2-4 years)

**Education:**

  

* Engineering or Management degree (preferably from a top tier institute IITs, IIMs, NITs, BITS etc.)

title: Product Manager
job_description:
About RapidClaims

RapidClaims is a leader in AI-driven revenue cycle management, transforming medical coding and revenue operations with cutting-edge technology.

The company has raised $11 million in total funding from top investors, including Accel and Together Fund.

Join us as we scale a cloud-native platform that runs transformer-based Large Language Models rigorously fine-tuned on millions of clinical notes and claims every month. You’ll engineer autonomous coding pipelines that parse ICD-10-CM, CPT® and HCPCS at lightning speed, deliver reimbursement insights with sub-second latency and >99 %

accuracy, and tackle the deep-domain challenges that make clinical AI one of the hardest—and most rewarding—problems in tech.

Product Manager - Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager with 4+ years of proven expertise to drive innovation in healthcare technology and revenue cycle management (RCM). In this role, you will be responsible for leading the discovery, design, and delivery of products that improve medical coding, claims processing, and overall healthcare efficiency. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to shape the roadmap and deliver products that make a measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

● Define and own product features and requirements across the healthcare/RCM product suite.

● Conduct customer research, market analysis, and competitor benchmarking to identify opportunities for innovation.

● Collaborate with engineering, design, and data science teams to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions.

● Act as product owner in Agile teams: manage backlogs, prioritize sprints, and ensure timely execution.

● Partner with sales, operations, and customer success to support go-to-market initiatives and adoption.

● Track and analyze product KPIs (adoption, retention, claim denial rates, cost savings) and continuously optimize for impact.

● Represent the voice of the customer (hospitals, physician groups, payers) and translate feedback into actionable product improvements.

● Stay up to date with industry trends in health-tech, RCM, AI/LLMs, and regulatory requirements.

Requirements

● Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field; MBA

preferred.

● 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in healthcare technology, SaaS,

or fintech.

● Strong understanding of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), medical coding, claims

workflows, or healthcare operations is highly desirable.

● Proven success in delivering products from concept to launch, managing

cross-functional teams.

● Data-driven mindset with experience using analytics tools (SQL, Python, BI tools).

● Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and product management tools (Jira,

Trello, Asana).

● Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

● Exposure to AI/ML or LLM-based solutions in healthcare or technology.

● Prior work in startups, consulting, or high-growth environments.

● Ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

Why Join Us?

● Opportunity to solve some of the most pressing challenges in healthcare and revenue

cycle management.

● Work on cutting-edge AI-powered solutions that directly impact hospitals, providers,

and patients.

● Collaborative and fast-paced startup culture with strong growth opportunities.

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Are you willing to work from Koramangala , Bangalore office
* How many years of experience in product management
* what is your current CTC
* What is your expected CTC
* What is your notice period to join

Work Location: In person

job_description:
Requisition Id: 16095

**About Narayana Health:**

Narayana Health is headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and operates a network of hospitals in India and Overseas. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, affordable healthcare services to the broader population. Narayana Health Group is Indias leading healthcare provider and one of the largest hospital groups in the country, with a network of 21 hospitals, 5 heart centres, and 19 primary care facilities. The NH group treats over 2.6 Million patients every year from over 78 countries, covering 30+ medical specialities.

For more details, please refer to our website at: https://www.narayanahealth.org

**About Medha:**

Medha is the Advanced Analytics & AI arm of Narayana Health, focused on transforming healthcare through data, intelligence, and thoughtfully designed digital products. Our mission is to simplify decision‑making across hospitals, clinics, and care teams by bringing clarity, precision, and actionability to every layer of healthcare operations.

Our products power large health systems, influence mission‑critical workflows, and support clinical and non‑clinical teams in delivering safer, faster, and more coordinated care.

For more details, please refer to our website at https://www.medha-analytics.ai/

**Why Join Medha?**

**Shape the Next-Generation Intelligence Products:**
  
Medha is building a unified intelligence ecosystem for healthcare. As a designer, you’ll influence products that drive decisions for clinicians, operations, business leaders, and frontline users.

**Be an Early Builder:**
  
Our design team is new and growing. You’ll play a foundational role in establishing the design culture, processes, and standards from the ground up.

**Solve Real, High-Impact Problems:**
  
Every product you design directly supports patient outcomes, operational efficiency, and healthcare quality across some of the largest health systems.

**User-Centric Discovery:**
  
You’ll have opportunities to meet users across hospitals, understand real-world behaviours, and translate them into actionable product experiences.

**Collaborative & Vision-Led Work:**
  
Work closely with product, engineering, and domain teams to deeply understand Medha’s core value proposition and solve problems with clarity and intent.

**Job Purpose:**

* Our colleague in this role will lead and directly manage key parts of the *Medha* Analytics product vision, development, and execution. This role is vital in the broader vision of running highly automated and efficient healthcare systems. In addition, the role will also be responsible to evangelize the technical platform and data assets across the company to achieve buy-in to the platform and understand if the intended impact is delivered. This product role is part of the Advanced Analytics & AI division at Narayana Health.
* This role requires close collaboration with other product managers, data engineering, functional teams, and the technical teams of various underlying applications.
* The right candidate will be able to articulate a platform & product vision and be capable of blending the needs from different technical & business groups into a well-formed technical product & platform road map. Furthermore, this person will have a diverse background and a demonstrable track record of successfully building and managing scaled, high-quality, innovative data platforms and technical services for internal or external customers. The right candidate must be a self-motivated team player who can contribute to the overall business objectives of the organization.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Define and lead the overall product vision, scope, requirements, usability of end user facing products built on the *Medha* Analytics Platform.
* In partnership with the data engineering team, functional team, and core business users, prioritize and lead product feature development.
* Define, communicate, and analyse success metrics for the products and the product vertical.
* Proposes multiple potential solutions for complex or new problems or processes and makes objective recommendations as to which direction should be taken.
* Provide transparency and recommendations on project trade-offs and provide dependency coordination.
* Perform with a wide degree of latitude on creative solutions.
* Continually assess and integrate internal & external customer feedback and business metrics.
* Stay on top of market trends to determine new or enhanced product capabilities that positively impact the business objectives.

**Candidate Requirement:**

***Education:***

* PGDM from a leading management institute
* B.E/ B.Tech Computer Science or related technical discipline or its equivalent.

***Experience:***

* 4 years experience in a technical Product Management team working very closely with analysts, database teams or as an individual
* A minimum of 3 years of experience in the analytics tech stack, ETL/Data Transformation and Data Visualization, Data Science tools
* Hands-on Experience with modelling, data science, data visualization and data governance.

***Preferred Qualifications:***

* Comfortable working with Big Data technologies building and designing products that utilize both real time as well as batch data streams at scale.
* Ability to write and validate SQL queries and to ensure data is validated.
* Ability to understand ETL structures and concepts.
* Ability to understand data visualization structures and concepts.
* Demonstrated data driven decision-making capabilities. Strong analytical skills to influence product decisions.
* Experience taking direction and input from multiple sources and creating a shared product vision.
* Demonstrated ability to work on a diverse scope of projects requiring detailed analysis, creative/practical problem solving, and sound judgement.
* Understanding of the technical architecture of complex data products.
* Project management of analytics / data intelligence projects.
* Strong communication skills.

title: Lead Product Manager
job_description:
**Level Up Your Career!**

At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile and the indie PC and Console space.

As well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door-to-door transport scheme, free food & drinks, free game codes & merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5.

**Join The Team!**

Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Lead Product Manager to shape what comes next in our live games: what we change, why, and what it will earn.

You’ll team up with our Executive Producers: they lead how we build; you lead what we build and why, and together you make our games better and better.

We’ll match the title to your experience. This role is for you if you’re a product leader who loves living in player data, forming bold hypotheses about retention, engagement, and monetisation, running clean experiments, and turning results into confident decisions.

This role is based in our Bangalore studio, working onsite 5 days per week, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.

### **What You’ll Do:**

* **Understand the games inside out.** Know the key numbers for each game, find the biggest opportunities in retention, engagement, economy, and monetisation, and size them.
* **Start with a hypothesis.** Turn every opportunity into a clear hypothesis with a success metric, so every feature ships with a purpose.
* **Run experiments that decide.** Design A/B tests with our product analysts, read them with an open mind, and decide together with the producer what ships next.
* **Shape the roadmap.** Build and prioritise the game roadmap with the Executive Producer, ranked by the value it will create.
* **Connect growth and product.** Bring what UA and creative learn about our players into the games, and work with monetisation on the best player experience.
* **Grow the product craft.** Guide our product analysts and help set how we do product across the portfolio.
* **Spot tomorrow’s hits.** Bring a product view to our most promising new games as they grow.

### **What You’ll Own:**

Great product decisions and the extra player value that they will create in our biggest games.

You’ll be the champion who ensures every big player opportunity gets a smart hypothesis, a clear experiment, and a place on the roadmap.

**How we’ll celebrate your success:**

* Growth in LTV and profit from product changes
* Retention, engagement, and monetisation in your games
* Experiments launched, learned from, and shipped
* Clear, well-reasoned roadmap decisions

### **What We’re Looking For:**

**Essential**

* Senior product management experience in F2P mobile games, with live games you’ve measurably improved.
* Strong analytical skills: At home with cohorts, funnels, and experiment design; A great understanding of game economies, progression, LiveOps, and hybrid monetisation.
* A hypothesis-driven mindset: you know what you expect to happen, why, and what you’ll do if you’re wrong.
* Experience partnering closely with producers or game leads
* A clear, warm communicator who makes the case in players and pounds.

**Desirable**

* SQL experience.
* Experience guiding or mentoring analysts.
* Puzzle or hybrid-casual mobile game experience

### **Why Kwalee?**

* **Generous Holiday:** Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!
* **Flexible Working:** We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.
* **Health Cover:** Private Medical Insurance covering you and your family
* **Free Food & Drink:** Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.
* **Gaming Goodies:** Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!
* **Transport:** Save on your commute with our budget-friendly, door-to-door transport facility.
* **Office Location:** Work from our Bangalore office immersing yourself in the dynamic heart of India's Silicon Valley, where explosive career opportunities seamlessly blend with a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle and fantastic year-round weather.
* **Professional Development:** Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* **Merch & Events:** Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.

### **Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**

At Kwalee, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer, where we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving creativity. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment where everyone can thrive.

Our culture is built on celebrating the diverse voices of our team members, fuelling innovation and strengthening our connection to our players. We are dedicated to advancing equity, diversity, and inclusion across all areas of life, including age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation.

We recognise the importance of self-development, career progression, and well-being in retaining our talented team. At Kwalee, we celebrate individuality and encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: AI Product Manager I / II - Talent Forge
job_description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
  
  
Job ID
  
68764232879
  
Date posted
  
10/01/2026
  
Department
  
Product
  
  
Eightfold is a global leader in an AI-native enterprise talent platform, trusted by the world’s largest & most respected Fortune 500 organizations. Our platform is built from the ground up, operating at scale across Azure and AWS, deployed in multiple regions globally, including IL4-compliant environments for the US Government, supporting users in 100+ countries and 30+ languages. Today, Eightfold is at the forefront of agentic AI, delivering intelligent agents that actively drive outcomes across hiring and talent workflows, while much of the industry is still experimenting with prototypes. Backed by over $410M in funding and valued at $2B+, we are defining the next era of agentic talent systems.
  
  
What sets Eightfold apart is not just the technology & our mission, but the team behind it. We are a deeply technical, execution-driven organization that values ownership, collaboration, and high standards. Our engineers, product leaders, and go-to-market teams work closely together — in person and across functions — to build systems that scale in the real world. If you’re excited to work on hard problems, move with urgency, raise the bar every day, and help build agentic systems that transform how the world works, Eightfold is the place to do it.
  
  
**About the Product:**  
The rules of building software have changed. What used to take a large team many months can now be built by a small, focused team in a fraction of the time. AI has collapsed the cost and time of software creation by an order of magnitude — and this shift is not coming, it is here.
  
  
Eightfold has an opportunity to help every customer reimagine their talent tech stack. We have deep domain expertise, world-class data infrastructure, and new internal capabilities that turn product vision into working software in days, not quarters.

title: Lead Product Manager
job_description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Lead Product ManagerOverview:  
  
Mastercard's Operational Intelligence team is building the next generation of data products, and AI solutions that help customers access and use operational insights in new ways. As part of this effort, the team is developing innovative products that deliver data through APIs and conversational experiences, creating alternatives to traditional reporting solutions.  
  
Role:  
  

* Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities, define product vision, business requirements, and strategic priorities, translating them into actionable project and delivery plans.
* Drive product and business strategy by evaluating customer needs, operational challenges, market trends, and business objectives to recommend new capabilities, processes, and solutions.
* Ensure methodology compliance and manage resolutions, reporting to management when necessary.
* Ensure timely and accurate communication with project staff and stakeholders throughout the lifecycle of initiatives. Monitor and manage project budgets, timelines, dependencies, and resource requirements.
* Must be familiar with business objectives, product goals, project scope, and team responsibilities in order to effectively coordinate activities across cross-functional teams.
* Identify and monitor project, product, and business risks, proactively developing mitigation plans to ensure successful outcomes.
* Regularly communicate strategic recommendations, product updates, business impacts, and project status to senior management and key stakeholders.
* Provide measurable input into new products, processes, standards, operating models, and strategic plans in support of business growth and organizational objectives.
* Effectively lead cross-functional teams to align with business objectives, product strategy, project schedules, and budget expectations.
* Effectively deal with difficult situations, navigate ambiguity, and help develop solutions to complex business and operational challenges.

  
All About You:  

* Advanced knowledge and demonstrated expertise in the areas of strategy, product management, business planning, and project management processes and techniques.
* Experience developing business cases, product roadmaps, requirements, and executive-level presentations.
* Knowledge of structured project management methodologies, planning tools, and product management frameworks.
* Excellent listening, oral, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong organizational, planning, prioritization, and multi-tasking skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to evaluate complex business challenges and recommend actionable solutions.
* Strong leadership, interpersonal, relationship-building, and negotiation skills with a solid track record of influencing cross-functional teams and building internal and external relationships.
* Demonstrate strategic thinking, business acumen, ethics, and values that foster credibility, trust, and collaboration across teams and stakeholders.
* Ability to balance long-term strategic objectives with day-to-day execution and delivery responsibilities.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Director of Product
job_description:
This Director , product Management will be responsible for designing, developing, and overseeing innovations in core Clearwater investment data management platform namely Single Data Plane . Our market leading, cloud native, single instance multi-tenant architecture intakes data from thousands of sources and creates a golden source of truth.

Reporting to VP, Product Management based in the U.S, this role will oversee defining the product requirements and planning its development to production and working closely with clients to make them successful. Additionally, the Product Manager is tasked with crafting the product roadmap necessary to achieve bookings, client NPS, and gross margin targets associated with their component.

To facilitate growth, the product manager will collaborate with internal stakeholders, clients, and prospects to identify new product capability requirements. They maintain close collaboration with their development teams to ensure the successful creation and introduction of these new capabilities to the market. Furthermore, the Product Manager takes charge of testing and implementing these fresh features with clients and actively promotes future growth to a broader audience of Clearwater clients and prospects.

**Responsibilities:**

* Team Span: responsible for handling 2 – 3 scrum teams spanning 12 – 15 engineers
* Continuously evaluate current data platform, and build a short (0 – 6 months), medium (6 – 12 months) and longer-term roadmap for a highly scalable, automated and resilient data platform
* Prioritize decisions across products with data driven justification
* Establish alignment on the product roadmap among multiple development teams.
* Efficiently lead the development of cross-product capabilities.
* Contribute to the formulation of the department's development and training plan.
* Advocate for a culture of communication throughout the organization.
* Build release specific product briefs that articulate the client problem for target personas, value, priority and high-level approach
* Keep current with latest technology development in data management, competitors and apply those insights to CW product strategy and execution.

* Prior experience in Investment management industry with strong knowledge of Security Reference, Trade, Analytics, Pricing, Accounting(ABOR/IBOR) , Performance, Custody data domains is a must have.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager I
job_description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

The Senior Product Manager I will help shape and advance reporting capabilities for Nielsen's Ads and Outcomes measurement portfolio. These products help clients understand advertising performance, audience delivery, and business outcomes through clear, trusted, and actionable insights. The role will help bring together customer needs, data, design, technology, and AI to create experiences that make complex measurement easier to explore and use.

You will own product work from discovery through launch and adoption. You will work with product, engineering, design, and client-facing teams. The ideal candidate is a self-starter. You create structure in ambiguous situations. You move initiatives forward. You make practical decisions based on customer needs, business value, data, and technical feasibility.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define product direction for assigned areas in alignment with business goals and customer needs.
* Translate customer, market, and commercial insights into clear product opportunities; partner with Design and Engineering to shape scalable solutions.
* Own the roadmap and backlog, making prioritization and trade-off decisions; develop product requirements, and prototypes.
* Lead initiatives through discovery, delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Use research customer feedback to guide decisions; build alignment across the organization to move these decisions forward through influence.
* Ensure product experiences are consistent across user interfaces, APIs, and other delivery channels.
* Define product goals, KPIs, and adoption measures, and use them to evaluate impact.
* Identify high-value opportunities to apply AI, automation, and emerging technologies to simplify workflows and improve customer outcomes.
* Shape connected AI product experiences that bring together related data and insights to help users answer broader business questions.
* Contribute to a strong product culture by sharing knowledge, supporting teams, and raising the quality of product thinking.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 6+ years of experience in product management.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field preferred; a Master’s degree is a plus.
* Experience in SaaS, DaaS, analytics, data products, or enterprise software.
* Experience taking complex initiatives from concept through launch and adoption, guiding collaborative teams and influencing without formal authority.
* Experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to understand data models, data flows, metrics, and measurement methodologies.

Marketing

  

**Job description**

Work/responsibilities regularly span multiple job families within this job group. Develops and executes comprehensive marketing, business development, brand and external communication strategies, tactical plans and programs to optimize market share and profitability. Identifies, develops and maintains customer and partner relationships and meet service requirements. Partners cross-functionally (e.g., with sales). Leads market research to assess current and future market conditions, competitive product, service and pricing practices and changing customer/prospect dynamics in order to influence new product/service development. Includes Marketing Operations. Plans, develops and manages marketing events (e.g., trade shows, conventions, sales meetings) for internal and/or external clients. **Job requirements**

**Responsibilities:**

* Own and manage the product strategy, positioning and lifecycle for the portfolios in India.
* Drive Market Development – segmentation, targeting, product positioning, new product launches and pricing.
* Lead Product Promotions – communication, discounting, schemes, offers and deals – to build brand equity and drive sales.
* Conduct ongoing market research, competitive analysis and voice-of-customer/voice-of-sales inputs to identify trends, growth opportunities and customer needs.
* Develop market segmentation and target customer profiles to guide positioning and messaging.
* Design and own the annual marketing and product plan, aligning brand priorities with business and sales objectives.

* Ensure timely and accurate reporting.
* Actively participate in T&E events and conferences, promoting products and engaging with customers to deepen market understanding.

* Minimum 7 years’ work experience in the MNC Medical Devices or specialty Pharma industry, with experience in training and/or selling.
* Excellent stakeholder management and ability to handle key accounts.
* Strong value orientation and performance track record.
* Management degree required; BDS preferred.
* Other desired skills:
* Sound clinical/product knowledge of dental implants and related surgical & prosthetic workflows
* Ability to identify, build and communicate product value propositions relatable by clinicians
* Strong customer service mindset
* Able to work in a cross functional, matrixed environment
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority
* Tech-savvy, fully competent in IT (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Windows OS)
* Highly developed communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
* Strong ability to understand and deliver on technical/clinical user requirements
* Hands-on, detail-oriented, and meticulous nature
* Proactive, self-driven, good analytical and outstanding problem-solving skills
* Strong analytical and market research skills, with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations
* Proven ability to develop segmentation frameworks and conduct competitive analysis
* Strategic planning and business acumen, with the ability to align product plans with sales and business objectives
* Willingness to travel extensively across the assigned territory

Actual compensation packages take into account a wide range of factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to geographic location; skill sets; relevant education and certifications; depth of experience; performance; and other business and organizational needs. author: Hiring Manager
title: Business Development & Product Manager (EdTech SaaS)
job_description:
**About the Role**

We are hiring a Business Development & Product Manager who can win institutional customers and shape the product they buy. You will own the school and college sales pipeline from first conversation to onboarding, run pre-sales and product demos, and carry what you hear from institutions back into the product roadmap.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Development**

* Identify, pitch and close deals with schools, colleges, universities and education groups.
* Build and manage a pipeline of leads through outreach, referrals, education events and partnerships.
* Handle the full sales cycle: discovery, proposal, pricing, negotiation, contract and handover.
* Work with decision-makers such as principals, directors, trustees, deans, HODs, IT heads and admin teams.
* Meet quarterly and annual revenue targets and report pipeline health to leadership.

**Pre-Sales & Demos**

* Run discovery calls to understand each institution's workflows, pain points and budget.
* Deliver tailored product demos, onsite and online, that map features to the institution's needs.
* Lead pilots and proofs of concept, and respond to RFPs and tenders.
* Prepare proposals, ROI cases, comparison decks and demo environments.

**Product Management**

* Convert customer feedback and market insights into product requirements, user stories and roadmap priorities.
* Work with engineering, design and customer success on feature releases.
* Track competitors and education trends such as NEP, accreditation requirements and digital learning.
* Define product positioning, packaging and pricing with leadership.
* Write product collateral, user guides and sales enablement material.

**Customer Success & Growth**

* Support smooth onboarding and adoption after the sale.
* Drive renewals, upsells and referrals from existing institutions.
* Gather case studies and testimonials from successful implementations.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline. MBA or a technology/business postgraduate degree is preferred.
* 4-8 years in business development, pre-sales, product management or a mix of these.
* Proven experience selling to **schools and colleges**, with a track record of closing institutional deals.
* Hands-on experience in **pre-sales and product demos** for **education and SaaS products**.
* Strong understanding of the SaaS model: subscriptions, onboarding, churn, renewals and ARR.
* Familiarity with education products such as LMS, ERP, admissions, assessment or learning platforms.
* Strong skills in presentation, negotiation and stakeholder management.
* Ability to write PRDs, user stories and prioritised roadmaps.
* Comfort with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce) and product tools (Jira, Figma, Notion).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* An existing network among school chains, colleges or education groups.
* Experience with government or institutional procurement, RFPs and tenders.
* Knowledge of regional education boards (CBSE, ICSE, state boards) and higher-education norms (UGC, AICTE, NAAC/NBA).
* Experience with data and analytics for sales and product decisions.
* Willingness to travel for institution visits and education events.

Key Skills

Institutional sales, pre-sales, demo delivery, product management, roadmap planning, SaaS metrics, solution selling, negotiation, communication, CRM, analytical thinking.

What We Offer

* Competitive fixed salary plus performance-based incentives
* Ownership across sales and product, with a direct line to leadership
* Growth path toward Head of Growth or Head of Product

Pay: ₹1,400,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have hands-on experience selling SaaS/technology products to schools, colleges, universities, or other educational institutions?
* Have you independently handled the complete B2B/institutional sales cycle—from lead generation and discovery through proposal, negotiation, closure, and onboarding/handover?
* Do you have hands-on experience conducting product demos or pre-sales presentations for SaaS/EdTech/technology products?

Work Location: In person

**Role Overview**

The Segment Manager for DBS Treasures plays a pivotal role in driving the growth, profitability, and service excellence of the affluent client segment. This position requires a strategic thinker who is adept at managing complex financial metrics, driving frontline productivity, and implementing data-driven insights to enhance channel efficiency and client experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Driving RM Productivity:** Lead initiatives to optimize Relationship Manager (RM) performance across key sales and service metrics. Monitor and analyze performance data to identify areas for improvement and implement targeted coaching or process enhancements.
* **P&L Management:** Oversee and manage P&L metrics for the Treasures segment, ensuring business targets are met through effective resource allocation and strategic planning.
* **Frontline Engagement:** Act as a key liaison between management and the frontline team. Proactively engage with RMs and service staff to communicate strategy, address operational challenges, and ensure alignment on key performance indicators.
* **Strategic Segmentation:** Manage the end-to-end customer segmentation process, including the strategic execution of upgrades and downgrades to ensure the client base is appropriately serviced and aligned with segment value propositions.
* **Channel Efficiency:** Utilize data analytics to create actionable insights that drive overall channel efficiency. Develop and execute strategies to streamline operations and enhance the delivery of the Treasures service model.

**Requirements**

* **Domain Expertise:** Deep understanding of the affluent banking segment, including client needs, investment products, and service expectations.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Proven ability to analyze complex financial data, generate actionable insights, and translate them into strategic business decisions.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a track record of effectively influencing and collaborating with frontline teams and senior leadership.
* **Operational Excellence:** Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, formal banking environment.
* **Education:** A degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CFA, CFP) are highly advantageous.

**Location:**

Mumbai

**Job:**

Product Management

**Schedule:**

Regular

**Employee Status:**

Full time

======================================

**Product Manager - G**ynae

**Business Unit:**

India Business

  

**Grade:**

Mumbai

  
  
  

At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you **“Create your own sunshine”**— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.

Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?

  

As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”

  

**JOB SUMMARY:**

  

As a Product Manager (GPM) within Marketing, you will usually be office based. The role encompasses marketing and sales in collaboration with commercial management, headquarters (product brand planning), sales management, market access management, medical management, registration colleagues, communication agencies, and market advice groups. They also manage the Product Life Cycle (PLC) of Brands.

  

**YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

* Development, collaboration, implementation, & accountability for strategic and operational plans which optimize profitability, market share, and revenue growth for a brand portfolio in the short and long term. Applicant to lead various assignments to help the BU meet overall BU business goals
* Development of marketing and promotional plans for products to support the end consumer’s need
* Monitor business performance and support the portfolio with the help of regular tracking
* Market intelligence through primary research and customer connect
* Writing and executing strategic business and marketing plans in collaboration with important prescribers, opinion leaders, round tables, and other advisory groups
* Joint financial responsibility for budgets (advertising and promotion, conferences and symposia, sales brochures and other product documentation, website content, literature), as well as analysis of budget income and costs;
* initiating and coordinating marketing activities and projects
* Presentation to staff and training field staff for the same
* Visiting national and international congresses, hospitals, and key opinion leaders (KOLs);
* Translating the corporate brand strategy in close collaboration with headquarters, together with logos and visuals, working with corporate product budgets (approval for expenditure on projects, local communication strategies), and providing input into corporate product strategy;
* Discussion partner for first, second, and third-line professionals such as medical specialists, pharmacists, and other medical professionals, and for other DMU members (decision-making units) such as local and national formulary committees and insurance companies;
* Organizing advisory councils, acting as a discussion leader or chairman, or giving product presentations.
* Collaboration with internal & external media to ensure the proper execution of strategies

  

**Job Requirements**

  

**Educational Qualification**

B. Pharm / M. Pharm & MBA

  

**Experience**

3-5 years previous work experience.

  

Skills required include:

  

* Demonstrable success in marketing or sales;
* Strategic insight;
* Effective networking skills and planning ability;
* Creativity and persuasiveness;
* Analytical and conceptual strength;
* A strong and inspiring personality;
* Self-starting and entrepreneurial.
  

**Your Success Matters to Us**

  

At Sun Pharma, your success and well-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. *Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let’s create a brighter future together!*

title: Growth Product Manager - F&O
job_description:
Job Description

**Company:** Upstox

**Location:** Mumbai

**Work arrangement:** 5 days in the office

**Experience:** 3–7 years

**About Upstox**

Upstox is building the future of investing — simple, powerful, and accessible to everyone. As one of India's fastest-growing fintech platforms, Upstox is backed by leading global investors, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global. Our mission is to enable wealth creation for every Indian, serving millions of users ranging from first-time investors to experienced traders. We operate at speed, with purpose, and in an environment that values impact, ownership, and innovation.

  

**The Role: Growth Product Manager – F&O**

Futures & Options is one of the most active trading segments at Upstox, and this role sits right where F&O trader behavior meets business outcomes. As Growth Product Manager – F&O, you'll drive business growth and customer engagement across the F&O product, owning initiatives focused on activation, reactivation, revenue and ARPAU improvement.

You'll work closely with the Product Manager and business stakeholders to spot growth opportunities and translate business problems into clear, well-structured requirements. Your core ownership is business requirements, growth opportunities, F&O metrics, funnel optimization and business impact — documented through BRDs rather than PRDs. Your interaction with Design and Engineering will be relatively limited and largely routed through the Product Manager, with Business, Analytics/Data and other cross-functional teams as your day-to-day partners.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**F&O Growth & Business Metrics**

* Drive initiatives that improve key F&O growth metrics — activations, reactivations, engagement and ARPAU
* Identify opportunities across the customer journey that can positively impact revenue and business performance
* Analyze business and customer data to uncover growth opportunities, funnel gaps and areas of improvement
* Work with relevant stakeholders to define success metrics and measure business impact

**Business Requirements & Product Collaboration**

* Partner closely with the Product Manager to identify and prioritize business opportunities
* Translate business problems, customer insights and growth opportunities into detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)
* Clearly articulate the business objective, customer problem, requirements, use cases, expected outcomes and success metrics
* Work with the Product Manager to ensure business requirements translate effectively into product initiatives
* Participate in discussions around feature prioritization and business impact

**New Product & Feature Initiatives**

* Identify and propose new features or enhancements based on customer needs, market opportunities and business objectives
* Develop BRDs for new initiatives and work with the Product Manager through the product development lifecycle
* Support feature launches by defining business objectives, target users, adoption metrics and go-to-market requirements
* Track post-launch performance and recommend improvements to drive adoption and business impact

**Funnel & Growth Optimization**

* Analyze existing F&O customer funnels to identify drop-offs and opportunities for improvement
* Drive initiatives to improve activation, reactivation, conversion, feature adoption and engagement
* Evaluate existing product features and customer journeys to find opportunities for optimization
* Use data and experimentation insights to recommend changes that improve business outcomes

**F&O Domain Expertise**

* Bring a strong understanding of Futures & Options trading and trader behavior
* Understand key F&O customer journeys, use cases and pain points
* Monitor market and industry trends to identify relevant growth and product opportunities
* Translate F&O business and customer needs into actionable product requirements

**How Success Is Measured**

This role is closely tied to measurable business outcomes: F&O activation, reactivation, ARPAU, revenue impact, funnel conversion, feature adoption, customer engagement and the performance of the growth initiatives you drive.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **Experience:** 3–7 years in Product Management, Growth, Business/Product Strategy, Fintech or a similar role
* **F&O exposure:** Hands-on experience with, or strong exposure to, F&O trading products
* **Commercial sense:** A strong understanding of business metrics, revenue levers and growth metrics
* **Growth track record:** Experience working on initiatives involving activation, reactivation, ARPAU, conversion or revenue improvement
* **BRD craft:** Experience creating Business Requirement Documents and translating business problems into clear requirements
* **Product partnership:** Understanding of the product development lifecycle and experience working closely with Product Managers
* **Analytical rigour:** Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify opportunities through data
* **Stakeholder management:** Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across Business, Product and Analytics
* **Ownership:** The ability to work independently and drive business initiatives from problem identification through implementation and measurement

**Why This Role Rocks**
-----------------------

* You'll own growth for F&O, one of the most active and revenue-critical segments on one of India's fastest-growing trading platforms.
* Your work is tied directly to outcomes that matter — activation, reactivation, ARPAU and revenue - so your impact is visible and measurable.
* You'll shape what gets built, turning trader insight and data into BRDs that become real product initiatives.
* You'll work alongside sharp Product, Business and Analytics teams who move fast and care about doing it right.
* Every initiative you drive will shape how millions of Indian traders experience the markets.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our Prospective Employee Privacy Notice, which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ("PI"). I accept Upstox's Prospective Employee Privacy Notice.

Upstox is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics.

job_description:
About the Role
  
  
We are seeking a highly analytical and passionate Assistant Technical Product Manager to join our product team at PayU Innovations. This role will work closely with the Technical Product Manager to define, document, and deliver complex fintech products, with a particular focus on the Account Aggregator ecosystem and other fintech products.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong technical background who wants to grow their product skills in a highly technical, fast-paced fintech environment.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities:**  

* Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for data platform capabilities, grounded in customer needs, enterprise reuse, and long-term platform scalability
* Lead continuous product discovery to identify high-impact problems, validate assumptions, and define outcome-oriented opportunities before delivery
* Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, and Analytics to deliver platform capabilities that treat data as a product with clear consumers, quality standards, and success measures
* Define and track product outcomes, success metrics, and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs); reassess strategy and priorities based on evidence and learning
* Translate complex technical and data concepts into clear product intent, trade-offs, and priorities for cross-functional teams. Develop product documentation, enablement materials, and executive-ready communications to support go-to-market efforts
* Maintain a prioritized and continuously refined backlog balancing near-term delivery with long-term platform evolution

**Qualifications:**  

* B.E or B.Tech from premier institute from Tier 1 or Tier 2 college in India (MBA preferred)
* Minimum 2 years of product management experience, preferably in Banks/NBFCs or fintechs.
* Strong understanding of software development processes, data science and web technologies.
* Understanding UX building tools like Figma & AI tools like Lovable and Claude Code for building quick journeys.
* Preferred experience with Business Rules Engines (BRE) and a decent understanding of credit underwriting processes, repayments and collections.

**Required Skills:**  

* Strategic Thinking: Ability to think strategically and develop comprehensive, data-driven product plans. Must be able to identify long-term opportunities and challenges while balancing short-term needs.
* Technical Proficiency: Strong technical acumen with an understanding of software architecture, data systems, data science and modern software development practices. Familiarity with APIs, cloud services, infrastructure and scalable platforms is highly desirable.
* User-Centric Design: Experience with user-centered design principles and practices. Ability to work closely with UX/UI teams to ensure the product meets high usability standards and addresses user pain points effectively.
* Analytical Skills: Proficient in using analytics tools to monitor success metrics and make data-driven decisions. Ability to interpret complex data and turn insights into actionable changes.
* Project Management: Excellent project management skills, including the ability to define project scopes, allocate resources, manage timelines, and mitigate risks.
* Communication and Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate ideas clearly and persuasively at all levels of the organization. Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Adaptability: High adaptability in a dynamic and rapidly changing environment. Must be comfortable with ambiguity and able to pivot strategies quickly based on new information.
