The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Support product strategy, roadmap execution, backlog management, and delivery planning for CDFT and related workforce planning solutions
* Partner with existing product ownership to define priorities, clarify requirements, and drive execution across multiple workstreams
* Support emerging Optum Health Capital App work, including requirements intake, workflow definition, stakeholder alignment, and delivery coordination
* Translate complex workforce planning, financial planning, capital planning, portfolio management, and operational requirements into clear epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Coordinate across finance, portfolio management, operations, technology, engineering, and leadership stakeholders to keep work moving and decisions clear
* Drive backlog refinement, prioritization discussions, user acceptance testing, release readiness, and post-release feedback loops
* Help assess and support transition planning for future enterprise headcount forecasting platforms
* Partner with technical teams to ensure product requirements are feasible, scalable, secure, and aligned to enterprise direction
* Track open questions, risks, decisions, dependencies, and follow-up items across multiple stakeholder groups
* Support adoption planning, user communications, training readiness, and support model design for workforce planning and forecasting capabilities
* Use enterprise-approved AI and productivity tools to improve product management workflows, documentation, analysis, and stakeholder communications
* Monitor product usage, user feedback, data quality concerns, and operational pain points to inform ongoing enhancements
* Prepare clear updates, decision materials, and product documentation for business and technology leadership
* Help ensure product work is organized, transparent, and moving at the pace required by senior stakeholders
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate degree or equivalent experience
* 8+ years of experience in technical product management, technology delivery, business systems analysis, technical program management, software delivery, or related roles
* 4+ years of experience supporting enterprise applications, workforce planning tools, financial planning systems, analytics platforms, resource planning solutions, or operational technology products
* 3+ years of experience with backlog items, process flows, requirements documentation, or technical product specifications
* Experience partnering directly with engineering, analytics, finance, operations, and business stakeholders
* Experience leading backlog refinement, prioritization, UAT, release readiness, and stakeholder review discussions
* Experience managing multiple priorities, dependencies, and stakeholder groups in a fast-paced environment
* Experience using data, reporting, or analytics to inform product decisions
* Solid communication skills with the ability to summarize complex topics clearly for senior stakeholders
* Ability to operate independently, drive follow-up, and bring recommendations forward rather than waiting for direction

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or similar certification
* Experience supporting workforce planning, headcount forecasting, capacity planning, financial forecasting, capital planning, portfolio management, or PMO processes
* Experience with healthcare technology, enterprise technology operations, or financial planning and analysis processes
* Experience with Power BI, SQL, Excel, Power Query, Power Platform, or related analytics and reporting tools
* Experience working with engineering teams using Agile/Scrum delivery models
* Experience supporting enterprise product migrations, support model setup, operational readiness, or platform adoption
* Experience incorporating automation, AI-assisted workflows, predictive forecasting, or decision-support capabilities into business applications
* Experience preparing executive-ready updates, product roadmaps, decision logs, and stakeholder communications
* Ability to work effectively with distributed teams across India and US time zones
* Technology and Tool Exposure
  + Agile delivery tools such as Jira, ADO, or Rally
  + Power BI
  + Excel / Power Query
  + SQL
  + Power Platform
  + Workforce planning or forecasting tools
  + Financial planning, portfolio, or capital planning platforms
  + AI-assisted productivity and product management tools, including Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Claude, or similar tools

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone - of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income - deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Senior Product Manager, Platform and Gateway
job_description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa's Client Platforms and Enterprise Tools team owns the platforms that govern how clients and partners securely connect to Visa's APIs. As Sr. Product Manager, you will drive product strategy and execution for the Visa Developer Platform's API Gateways, the encryption and key management capabilities that protect data in transit, and Visa's India data localization operations. Direct product strategy from product conception and definition through implementation. Identifies new business and market opportunities and creates appropriate business plans

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Key Responsibilities

* **Own product strategy and the long-term roadmap for the Inbound API Gateway and its associated developer portal onboarding flows**
* **Define the roadmap for authentication and encryption mechanisms supported at the gateway (mTLS, PQC, OAuth, JWT/JWK) and prioritize new auth capabilities against client and regulatory demand**
* Own security configuration capabilities such as header whitelisting, and prioritize enhancements based on emerging threat models and client requirements
* Run front-door intake meetings and prioritize incoming feature, security, and integration requests from internal product teams and partners
* Manage the regional deployment roadmap, ensuring gateway capabilities and security configurations are rolled out consistently across regions
* Partner with security, cryptography, and platform engineering teams to validate that new authentication and encryption capabilities meet Visa's security and compliance bar
* Define and track performance key results (latency, availability, onboarding time, auth failure rates) to ensure ongoing product readiness
* Own documentation and enablement materials so internal teams and partners can self-serve gateway onboarding and configuration
* Monitor support/incident trends related to authentication and security configuration, feeding recurring issues back into the roadmap
* Present roadmap, KPIs, and key security/compliance decisions to leadership and governance forums on a recurring cadence
* Support daily operational needs requiring data access and retrieval by India-localized personnel, ensuring timely turnaround for internal and client requests
* Help ensure India-localized platforms and tools run reliably as a cohesive product suite, coordinating fixes and improvements across the underlying systems

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* + 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or 7 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree, or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD
* + **Proven experience as a Product Manager owning API platforms, gateways, or security/authentication infrastructure**
  + **Working knowledge of API authentication and security standards (OAuth, mTLS, JWT/JWK) and emerging areas such as post-quantum cryptography**
  + **Familiarity with encryption concepts (message-level and field-level encryption) and key management lifecycle practices**
  + Experience running intake/prioritization processes and setting product roadmaps for multiple concurrent workstreams
  + Experience partnering closely with security and cryptography engineering teams on regulated or compliance-sensitive capabilities
  + Understanding of data localization or data residency regulatory requirements is a plus
  + Strong stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, security, and compliance partners
  + Comfortable working with agile frameworks such as Scrum or Kanban

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Senior Product Manager- HCM
job_description:
We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who is passionate about building products that customers love. You will join a dynamic and fast-paced environment and work with cross-functional teams to design, build and roll-out products that deliver the company’s vision and strategy.

**Your responsibilities:**

  

* Gain a deep understanding of customer experience, identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas that grow market share, improve customer experience and drive growth
* Create buy-in for the product vision both internally and with key external partners
* Develop product pricing and positioning strategies
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes
* Scope and prioritize activities based on business and customer impact
* Work closely with engineering teams to deliver with quick time-tomarket and optimal resources
* Drive product launches including working with public relations team, executives, and other product management team members
* Evaluate promotional plans to ensure that they are consistent with product line strategy and that the message is effectively conveyed
* Act as a product evangelist to build awareness and understanding
* Represent the company by visiting customers to solicit feedback on company products and services
* Create long- and short-term product sales forecasts and analysis for management
* Bring new products to market with return-on-investment analysis
* Market new products with sales, advertising and production teams Determine product pricing based on market research, production costs and anticipated demand

Schedule and assign operational requirements to follow up on work results

* Manage the product team, including coaching and disciplinary actions, planning, monitoring and job appraisal
* Continue professional and technical education, attending workshops, seminars, etc.

**Skill sets/Experience we require:**

* Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager
* Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and effectively communicate recommendations to executive management
* Skilled at working effectively with cross functional teams in a matrix organization
* Proven track record of working with designers, engineers, and various stakeholders to coordinate, plan, execute, and track product releases from beginning to end.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Outstanding project and time management skills
* Strong problem solving skills and willingness to think outside the box and roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done
* Familiarity with agile software development methodologies is also a plus.

**Pedigree:**

  

* Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science or related field

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager - Technical
job_description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Product Manager - TechnicalOverview  
  
As an employee at Mastercard you are expected to demonstrate 'Mastercard Way' cultural values every day – create value, grow together and move fast – with a relentless focus on doing the right things. As a Senior Product Manager - Technical at Mastercard, you are expected to perform the following general responsibilities:
  
  
About the role -Responsible for understanding business needs, market opportunities, and technology trends
  
  
Owns the vision for one or more features
  
  
Decomposes business requirements and customer experiences into features and functions that drive the platform/product roadmap.
  
  
Works with Technical Program Managers, Developers, UX designers, and internal customers to define the details behind the business requirements
  
  
Analyzes and interprets voice of the customer and product metrics as a feedback loop into the backlog and balances the priorities against new features
  
  
Recommends trade-off decisions on platform product features/depth of features/backlog items
  
  
Owns and manages product documentation ensuring features and associated documentation are clear and easily consumable by other engineering teams  
  
  
  
  
All about you
  
  
It is not expected that any single candidate would have expertise across all these areas.  
  
  
  
  
Collects and defines features
  
  
Proficient at grooming features & user stories, setting entrance/exit criteria and prioritizing a platform product backlog
  
  
Continuously monitors feature development at the feature level adjusting throughout implementation as needed
  
  
Reviews product demo against acceptance criteria for the feature set
  
  
Supports and participates in post-launch reviews and ensures feedback is reincorporated into the feature
  
  
Stays aligned with Go-To-Market plans for the feature set
  
  
Identifies issues that will keep the platform features from delivering on time and/or with the desired requirements and works with internal teams and customer service to identify, classify, and prioritize feature-level customer issues
  
  
Enables self-service support and/or works to reduce overhead
  
  
Take the time to fully learn the functionality, architecture, dependencies, and runtime properties of the systems involved with your projects. This includes the business requirements and associated use cases, Mastercard customer's experience, Mastercard's back-office systems, the technical slack (application/service architecture), interfaces and associated data flows, dependent applications/services, runtime operations (i.e., trouble management/associated support strategies), and maintenance.
  
  
Understands and can explain the business context and the associated customer use cases
  
  
Recognize discordant views and take part in constructive dialog to resolve them
  
  
May participate with the business in customer research to inform platform product feature needs
  
  
Improve team processes that accelerate delivery, drive innovation, lower costs, and improve quality
  
  
Verbal and written communication is clear and concise

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager (Only TIER - 1)
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager**

**Location**: Hyderabad / Nagpur | Experience: 4–8 Years

ARO.AI is being built by KC Overseas Education, a company that has run international education operations across 30+ countries for over 28 years. We are now building the AI layer on top of all that experience.

We are building an AI-powered CRM for study abroad consultants, universities and higher education institutions. Most of this industry still runs admissions and counselling on spreadsheets and CRMs that were never built for this workflow. We are changing that.

We are at an early stage and looking for a **Founding Product Manager** who wants to build, not just manage.

**What you will do**

* This is a **0 1 product ownership** role. You will work directly with the Founder and own the product end to end:

* **Talk to universities, counsellors and users** to identify real problems worth solving.
* Define **product strategy, roadmap** and priorities.
* Own the complete PDLC **from discovery wireframe PRD build launch adoption.**
* Work closely with 20+ engineers and designers to ship products fast.
* **Create wireframes and user flows** when needed and stay hands-on till execution.
* Decide what to build, what not to build and why.
* Use product data, customer feedback and business impact to improve the product.
* Identify where AI/agents can genuinely improve the international admissions journey.

**What we are expecting**

* **4–8 years** of Product Management experience with strong B2B SaaS exposure.
* **MBA from a Tier-1 institute** preferred. IIT/NIT/BITS or similar engineering background is a plus.
* Experience in an **early-stage startup** where you have built or significantly shaped products.
* Proven **ownership of products/features** from problem discovery to production.
* Strong product thinking, customer understanding and execution.
* Comfortable with **wireframing, PRDs, APIs, integrations** and working with engineering teams.
* AI/GenAI exposure is a plus, but strong SaaS product experience matters more.

**If you want a defined PM role, this is not it. If you want to build the product from the ground up, this is the role.**

* Strong product thinking, customer understanding and execution.
* Comfortable with **wireframing, PRDs, APIs, integrations** and working with engineering teams.
* AI/GenAI exposure is a plus, but strong SaaS product experience matters more.

**If you want a defined PM role, this is not it. If you want to build the product from the ground up, this is the role.**

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Technical Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Product Manager to support the Ancillary Benefits Management data platform, which serves as the technical foundation and orchestration layer for multiple healthcare managed-service offerings.

The Senior Technical Product Manager will translate prioritized product initiatives and features into clear, executable work for a large, cross-functional engineering organization. This role is accountable for maintaining a healthy and implementation-ready backlog, decomposing complex platform capabilities into manageable features and user stories, facilitating requirements clarification and grooming, and ensuring work is prepared for Program Increment planning and delivery.

The successful candidate will be highly organized, technically curious, proactive, and comfortable operating in a complex environment involving healthcare data, enterprise integrations, multiple engineering workstreams, and cross-functional stakeholders. This role requires someone who can identify ambiguity, close requirements gaps, build consensus, and drive work from concept through execution.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product execution and backlog readiness
  + Partner with Strategic Product Management to translate product priorities, initiatives, and parent features into executable engineering work
  + Own backlog readiness for the assigned ABM Platform engineering domain
  + Independently manage product execution and backlog readiness across multiple engineering teams operating within the assigned platform domain
  + Decompose complex platform capabilities and features into manageable user stories, enablers, and technical work
  + Develop clear user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, process flows, and nonfunctional requirements in partnership with Engineering and subject-matter experts
  + Lead backlog-refinement and requirements-grooming sessions
  + Ensure work is sufficiently defined, estimated, prioritized, sequenced, and ready before PI and sprint planning
  + Maintain traceability across initiatives, features, user stories, dependencies, PI commitments, and delivered capabilities
  + Keep product and Agile delivery tools current and aligned, including Aha and Rally
* Cross-functional delivery
  + Serve as a trusted product partner to Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Implementation, and other business and technology stakeholders
  + Facilitate requirements clarification and drive timely resolution of gaps, conflicts, and unresolved decisions
  + Manage dependencies across engineering workstreams, platform services, integrations, data domains, and partner teams
  + Identify technical, operational, and delivery risks early and drive appropriate mitigation or escalation
  + Track progress against PI commitments and communicate changes, blockers, tradeoffs, and delivery impacts clearly
  + Coordinate with product and engineering leaders to balance customer needs, operational requirements, technical constraints, performance, and platform sustainability
  + Coordinate effectively across India- and U.S.-based teams, providing clear written updates and facilitating decisions across time zones
* Technical product management
  + Develop a working understanding of assigned ABM Platform capabilities, end-to-end data flows, integrations, interfaces, and downstream consumers
  + Partner with Engineering and Architecture to evaluate implementation approaches and translate technical decisions into actionable backlog work
  + Ensure API, data-model, mapping, integration, configuration, and interface requirements are documented and reflected in appropriate engineering artifacts
  + Support integration testing, automation, release readiness, and implementation validation by verifying that requirements and acceptance criteria are complete
  + Ensure changes affecting shared platform capabilities are traceable and communicated to impacted stakeholders
* Engineering Partnership and Technical Leadership
  + Serve as the day-to-day product counterpart for Engineering leadership within the assigned platform domain.
  + Build trusted working relationships with Engineering Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, and developers
  + Facilitate decisions across Product and Engineering when requirements, architecture, delivery priorities, or implementation approaches are unclear
  + Drive alignment across distributed teams and create clarity when ownership or direction is ambiguous
  + Earn credibility through preparation, responsiveness, technical curiosity, and consistent follow-through
  + Influence without direct authority while maintaining momentum on complex initiatives
* Agile Planning and Delivery Leadership
  + Lead feature refinement, dependency management, PI readiness, and sprint planning activities for assigned engineering domains
  + Partner with Engineering leadership to identify delivery risks, capacity constraints, sequencing challenges, and cross-team dependencies
  + Facilitate Program Increment planning activities and ensure priorities are translated into executable engineering commitments
  + Drive accountability for action items, open questions, and delivery commitments
  + Proactively identify impediments and coordinate resolution before they affect delivery outcomes
* Continuous improvement
  + Improve backlog quality, requirements discipline, traceability, and delivery predictability
  + Identify recurring execution gaps and recommend practical improvements to product-management and engineering-delivery processes
  + Build transparent, collaborative relationships across distributed teams
  + Use evidence, delivery data, and stakeholder input to support recommendations and decisions
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience
* 7+ years of experience in technical product management, product ownership, product management, business systems analysis, or technology delivery
* Experience working directly with engineering leadership, architects, and distributed development teams
* Experience supporting PI planning, dependency management, and scaled Agile delivery
* Experience managing and prioritizing backlogs in an Agile product-development environment
* Experience partnering directly with engineering teams to clarify requirements and drive work through planning and delivery
* Experience with Agile and portfolio-management tools such as Aha, Rally, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools
* Demonstrated experience decomposing complex capabilities or features into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions and drive alignment across multiple engineering teams
* Demonstrated ability to understand and communicate end-to-end technical concepts, including data flows, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, or enterprise systems
* Demonstrated solid facilitation, written communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, cross-team dependencies, and delivery risks

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Scrum, Product Owner, SAFe, or comparable certification
* Experience with healthcare technology, healthcare payer operations, claims, prior authorization, clinical data, or managed-service platforms
* Experience supporting enterprise data platforms, data integration, data governance, APIs, or batch and real-time processing
* Experience operating within a scaled Agile or PI-planning environment
* Knowledge of cloud technologies, DevOps practices, integration testing, and automation
* Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 or FHIR

**Characteristics of Success**

* Takes ownership and follows work through completion
* Proactively identifies missing requirements, dependencies, and decisions
* Creates structure and clarity in ambiguous situations
* Speaks credibly with both business and technical stakeholders
* Builds trust through transparency, preparation, and consistency
* Challenges assumptions constructively and escalates risks appropriately
* Maintains solid attention to detail without losing sight of delivery outcomes
* Can manage a large, technically complex engineering domain with limited day-to-day direction
* Quickly establishes credibility with highly technical engineering teams
* Can operate effectively with senior engineers, architects, and engineering leadership
* Influences decisions through data, preparation, and sound judgment rather than positional authority
* Creates structure and forward momentum in complex environments with competing priorities
* Balances business needs, technical constraints, delivery timelines, and platform sustainability
* Comfortable challenging assumptions and facilitating difficult tradeoff discussions

**Location**

Location and Working Hours

* This position is based in Hyderabad, India
* The role requires regular collaboration with globally distributed teams, including colleagues based in the United States
* Candidates must be able to maintain consistent, reasonable overlap with designated U.S. working hours for planning, requirements clarification, stakeholder meetings, and delivery coordination
* Specific working-hour expectations will be discussed during the interview process

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to drive AI and systems strategy across the Service value chain, scheduling through invoicing, for the dealership users who actually repair vehicles. You'll own high-visibility capabilities that cut manual steps and review time for BDC agents, technicians, and service advisors, so they can spend their time on the work that actually needs a human.
  
  
This role is built for someone who thinks like a systems architect even though you're not writing the architecture yourself. You've shipped AI/ML product before. You understand how integrations and backend systems actually behave under load, not just in theory. And you bring enough seniority to set the framework, not just fill in a roadmap someone else built. Our team, known internally as the JiraHunters, values precision, attention to detail, and a relentless focus on solving hard problems properly the first time.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for AI/ML-powered Service capabilities across Scheduling, Repair Order Management, Parts Operations, Technician Workflows, and Invoicing
* Partner directly with ML/AI engineers to identify, prioritize, and productize AI use cases. You're in the room for the model conversation, not briefed on it afterward
* Define the success metrics that matter: accuracy, adoption, time saved, workflow efficiency, and hold the roadmap to them
* Design solutions that scale across dealership sizes, service volumes, and regional requirements without falling apart at the edges
* Set the systems design and framework standards other PMs on the team build against
* Use data to decide what to build next, not gut feel dressed up as a roadmap

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 8+ years of Product Management experience owning customer-facing SaaS products
* 2+ years of hands-on AI/ML product management experience: building ML-powered features, working directly with data scientists or ML engineers, understanding the model lifecycle end to end. This is required, not preferred
* Strong systems design and product architecture skills. You can design a scalable, extensible technical solution and explain why it's the right one. Non-negotiable for this role
* Experience leading distributed onshore and offshore teams
* Strong business acumen and the judgment to prioritize ruthlessly when everything looks urgent
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to partner closely with ML/AI engineers, design, data science, and GTM

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience in automotive service or aftermarket, or with dealer/OEM service workflows
* Understanding of diagnostic workflows, scheduling systems, or parts catalog systems
* Hands-on experience with LLMs, NLP, or recommendation systems
* Familiarity with responsible AI principles and model explainability
* Background in operations research, process optimization, or workflow automation

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in** **Ashby**

*Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!*

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice

title: Sr. Product Manager - B2C and Events
job_description:
**ABOUT US**

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

**OUR PEOPLE**

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

**OUR IMPACT**

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**

The B2C/Creators Product team at HighLevel is focused on building and scaling a world-class learning experience for our customers and their audiences. The platform currently serves over 1.1 million monthly active users, making it one of HighLevel's most widely adopted products. This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at scale while solving B2C-style learner experience problems within a B2B2C product ecosystem.

Events is one of the newest products in HighLevel's Memberships suite, currently in beta and being built from the ground up. It gives our customers a native way to create, publish and sell events — in-person, online and hybrid — with ticketing, RSVPs, paid and free registration, and attendee management, sitting directly alongside the contacts, communities, courses, credentials and automations they already run their business on. Organizers build and run their events from the Memberships admin; attendees live the whole thing inside Client Portal, next to the courses, communities and credentials they already sign in for.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Own and Shape the B2C & Events Roadmap** Partner with product leadership to help shape and execute the roadmap for HighLevel's B2C platform, serving 1.1M+ monthly active learners, with a focus on engagement, completion, and retention in a B2B2C environment.
* **Close the Table-Stakes Gap, Then Go Past It –** Know the category cold. Get the expected capabilities right — ticket tiers, promo codes, capacity and waitlists, recurring and series events, refunds, embeddable widgets, calendar sync, wallet passes — and then decide deliberately where we go further than the incumbents rather than matching them feature for feature.
* **Take Events from Beta to GA –** Own the beta exit criteria: the quality bar, the reliability bar, the feature completeness, and the adoption and revenue signals that tell us this product is ready to be sold broadly. Drive the program that closes those gaps.
* **Build Ticketing, Checkout and Payments –** Lead paid, free and RSVP event types, multi-tier and multi-currency ticketing, checkout conversion, discounts, taxes, refunds and payouts — with the precision and trust a revenue-bearing flow demands, and with fee and payout terms that are a reason to choose us rather than a reason to resent us.
* **Give Organizers Ownership of Their Audience –** Build the capability that most defines us against the category: every registration flows into the organizer's own CRM, segmentable, automatable and theirs to keep. Turn attendee data ownership from a talking point into the product's most obvious advantage.
* **Own Event-Day Operations –** Events are judged on the day they happen. Own check-in and QR scanning, offline resilience at the door, guest lists and comp tickets, on-site sales, capacity enforcement and the operational tooling organizers depend on when things go wrong in real time.
* **Own the Attendee Experience in Client Portal –** Client Portal is where the attendee side of Events lives, and you own it: how members find what is on, register and check out, hold their tickets, receive reminders and joining links, attend in person or online, and look back at what they have been to. Deliver that journey across both web and mobile, make events feel native to the portal rather than bolted onto it, and hold a phone-first bar throughout.
* **Drive Distribution and Discovery –** Shape how events get found and filled: SEO-ready event pages, social and calendar syndication, embeddable listings, the Gokollab Marketplace, and the promotion tooling that turns an organizer's existing audience into attendance.
* **Open the Platform –** Treat APIs, webhooks and integrations as a first-class surface rather than a premium upsell, so agencies and developers can build events into the workflows and client solutions they already sell.
* **Champion UI/UX Excellence –** Partner closely with design and engineering to deliver interfaces that are intuitive, accessible, mobile-friendly and fast — for both the organizer building an event and the attendee registering for one.
* **Talk to Organizers Constantly –** Run discovery with beta organizers, sit in on their setup, watch where they stall, and turn qualitative signal into a prioritized backlog. At this stage, direct customer contact is a primary input, not a supplement.
* **Experiment and Optimize –** Design and analyze experiments across the funnel — event page conversion, registration completion, checkout drop-off, organizer onboarding — and iterate rapidly on evidence rather than opinion.
* **Support Scale, Reliability and Trust –** Drive the platform work a live-event product demands: registration integrity, capacity and waitlist correctness, payment reliability, fraud and listing trust, and graceful behavior under the traffic spikes that come with a popular event going on sale.
* **Collaborate Cross-Functionally –** Work across engineering, design, data, support, marketing and customer-facing teams to launch features, drive adoption, and close the loop on organizer feedback.
* **Define and Own the Metrics –** Establish the success metrics for a product that does not yet have them — organizer activation, time to first published event, repeat-event rate, registration and checkout conversion, attendance rate, gross ticket volume and revenue per organizer — set the OKRs against them, and use them to steer the roadmap.
* **Deliver Outcomes, Not Just Features –** Be accountable for measurable growth in events published, organizers activated, registrations processed and ticket revenue running through the platform.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* **B2C Experience –** You have built and shipped impactful features for B2C platforms or content products, creating engaging end user experiences that drive activation, completion, and retention at meaningful scale.
* **An End-to-End Owner –** You are comfortable owning the entire life of an event across two connected surfaces: the creator experience in the Memberships admin, where an organizer builds, prices, publishes, promotes and runs their event, and the attendee experience in Client Portal, where a member discovers it, registers, attends and looks back on it. You think in terms of the whole journey and the handoffs between those surfaces, not in terms of screens.
* **UX-Attentive for Learning –** You bring a strong UI/UX sensibility focused on learner journeys, content discovery, progress tracking, and habit formation, with a track record of delivering intuitive and high-quality learning experiences.
* **Experimentation-Minded –** You are comfortable running A/B tests and structured experiments to improve learner engagement and completion rates through rapid, evidence-based iteration.
* **Learner-Centric –** You consistently balance business objectives with learner success, keeping learner needs, motivation, and outcomes at the center of product decisions.
* **Customer-Obsessed –** You seek out organizers directly, run your own discovery, and can translate what you hear into product decisions without waiting for a research team to formalize it.
* **Strategic and Execution-Focused –** You can contribute meaningfully to product vision while staying deeply involved in day-to-day execution to ensure ideas translate into real, measurable impact.
* **Data-Informed –** You rely on behavioral data, funnel metrics, and cohort analysis to prioritize initiatives, validate assumptions, and guide product decisions.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

* 7+ years of Product Management experience, with meaningful exposure to events, ticketing, marketplace, commerce or B2B2C SaaS products.
* Proven track record of taking a product from early stage to scaled adoption, with clear ownership of the decisions that made it work.
* Hands-on experience with monetization mechanics — checkout, pricing and packaging, payments, refunds, payouts and fee structure — and the operational realities that come with them.
* Working knowledge of the events and ticketing category, including how platforms such as Eventbrite, Luma, Meetup and Cvent are positioned, priced and differentiated.
* Solid understanding of UI/UX principles, with the ability to partner closely with design to deliver intuitive, accessible and high-quality journeys for two distinct user types: organizers and attendees.
* Familiarity with SaaS and B2C platform growth levers, including user activation, engagement loops, retention, lifecycle optimization, and audience monetization.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity, incomplete data and shifting priorities in a fast-moving, remote-first environment.
* Bonus: You have worked on an events, ticketing or community platform and can clearly articulate your personal impact on organizer growth, conversion and revenue.

**WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US?**

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters.

Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.

Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

**EEO Statement:**

The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.  
  
We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager, AI
job_description:
**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will serve as a Senior Product Manager for Teradata's vector search and unstructured data capabilities, driving product vision, strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption. You will define how enterprises turn documents, images, audio, and other unstructured content into searchable, trusted context that AI applications and agents can retrieve at scale, alongside the structured data they already manage in Teradata.

On the retrieval side, you will own the product direction for vector and hybrid search: indexing and approximate nearest neighbor techniques, filtering, ranking and re-ranking, and the balance between recall, latency, freshness, and cost. You will work with engineering to make vector search a first-class, SQL-native capability that performs at enterprise scale and concurrency, and you will define how relevance and quality are measured, not only how fast queries run.

On the ingestion side, you will own how unstructured data gets into the platform: connectors to object stores and enterprise content sources, document parsing, OCR, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental refresh. You will shape pipelines that are reliable, governed, and cost-efficient, with access controls, lineage, and sensitive-data handling that carry through from source to retrieved result.

Your impact will be measured by customers moving from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) prototypes to production AI applications and agents that run on trusted enterprise data, with measurable gains in answer quality, time to value, and cost per query.

**Who You Will Work With**

You will collaborate with customers, engineering, the database engine and SQL teams, AI platform and data science teams, cloud infrastructure, UX, governance and security, product marketing, and field teams to bring next-generation retrieval capabilities into Teradata's enterprise ecosystem. You will be responsible for ensuring our products meet business objectives.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from a recognized institution. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

* 6+ years of experience in software product development companies, including 3+ years in product management working with AI/ML, search, or data platform products.

* Strong knowledge of embeddings and vector search, including index types (such as HNSW and IVF), quantization, filtered and hybrid search (keyword plus vector), and re-ranking.

* Working understanding of RAG, LLMs, and AI agents, and how retrieval quality drives answer quality. Experience defining evaluation metrics such as recall, precision, and relevance.

* Understanding of unstructured data ingestion: document parsing, OCR, chunking strategies, multimodal content, metadata extraction, and embedding pipelines, including GPU considerations.

* Experience with data pipelines and connectors on cloud object storage, including batch and incremental or streaming ingestion.

* Experience with APIs, SDKs, and integrations for enterprise and developer adoption, including open ecosystems such as Python, Jupyter, and agent frameworks.

* Familiarity with the competitive landscape, such as Pinecone, Elasticsearch and OpenSearch, pgvector, Snowflake, Databricks, and MongoDB, and the ability to benchmark against it.

* Excellent communication skills, with a strong track record of customer engagement, product KPIs, and prioritization.

* Experience with AI productivity tools, and the ability to work independently and deliver high quality outcomes in fast-paced environments.

**What You Will Bring**

* Experience building search, retrieval, or data ingestion products at scale, with a clear view of the trade-offs between recall, latency, freshness, and cost.

* Hands-on exposure to building RAG applications or agents on structured and unstructured enterprise data.

* A quality mindset: the discipline to build benchmarks and evaluation sets, and to let data decide between approaches.

* A strong understanding of responsible AI, including explainability, auditability, and protection of sensitive data in retrieval.

* Vision to anticipate how agents will use retrieval, and to position Teradata's offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.

* Passion for intuitive developer and user experiences, such as natural language search and simple, SQL-friendly interfaces.

* Ability to influence engineering and go-to-market teams without direct authority, and to mentor others.

#LI-NM1

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

job_description:
**Please note that we will only be able to accept candidates who have the appropriate rights and documentation for employment in India.**

**Who we are.**

Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting. Our business has evolved into a world-class, multifaceted brokerage with offices in six regions. With heavy investment in the latest trading technology, Axi seeks to offer the most comprehensive end-to-end trading experience available, servicing traders of all levels from beginners to institutional-level clients.

**The Team & Role:**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager (Crypto Trading) to join Axi Crypto's Trading Product Team and work closely with the Head of Product to build and scale our multi-country trading products across Spot, Futures, Options and adjacent trading experiences.

This is a hands-on product execution role. You will drive trading products end-to-end — understanding trader needs, translating them into detailed product requirements, working closely with Engineering, Design, Ops, Compliance and Sec to drive execution, and ensuring what we ship works reliably under real-world crypto trading conditions.

You should enjoy getting deep into the details of trading systems and trader experiences — from order forms, calculations, order types, validation logic, order routing, order lifecycle and management, position management, P&L, chart trading, and more.

You will have significant ownership of your product area and be expected to make decisions, unblock teams and drive products from problem/opportunity definition detailed requirements build grow iteration.

**Your EDGE Assignment/You Will**

* Own and execute trading products across Spot & Derivatives (Futures, Options) - with sharp prioritization/trade-offs and a focus on stability, retention and risk mitigation.
* Write detailed specs that translate complex trading requirements into clear, executable requirements for Engineering and Design.
* Live & breathe our product sub culture of staking yourself behind everything you deliver.
* Go deep into the logic and mechanics of trading products - order types, validation rules, pricing, fees, margin, leverage, P&L, order states, positions, cancellations, failures, edge cases & risk-related flows.
* Work closely with Engineering to understand, co-own & influence the architecture, platform behaviour, APIs, MCPs, order lifecycles, dependencies and technical constraints - balancing correctness, reliability and speed.
* Partner with Design to build intuitive trading experiences without compromising functionality for our core trader types.
* Own the performance scorecard for your charter, resolve blockers and keep the team moving.
* Stay close to traders. Understand their behaviour. Channel trader feedback, your observation, product data and research to identify not just problems, but also opportunities - and continuously improve the trading product.
* Define success, metrics, monitor products after launch and drive continuous iteration. Sign off on everything that goes live from your roadmap.

**Are you the one?**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, with meaningful experience shipping equity or crypto trading products.
* Deep understanding of Spot & Derivatives (perps, options, etc.) trading mechanics and the order lifecycle.
* You write/orchestrate detailed product specs that Engineering teams & AI agents can directly execute against. You achieve 100% coverage of formulas, edge cases, state transitions, validations, failure scenarios, test cases etc.
* AI Native workflows. You use AI tools & LLMs as force multipliers, but with a strong human-in-the-loop judgement. Your PRDs & prototypes are not one-shot prompt AI slop.
* You force trade off conversations and ground your prioritizations in business reality.
* You have a knack for building products that carry an emotional valence
* You try to understand why a customer chooses Apple over others and why a trader will choose Axi over others.
* You understand trader psychology. Why they trade, what matters to them (and what does not). You can then translate these into product outcomes.
* You deeply care about what you're building, and can relentlessly champion the mission of your team.

**Axi's bag of delights**

* Competitive and attractive compensation.
* Extensive learning opportunities, such as professional training and certifications and soft skills development.
* 18 annual leave days per year.
* 12 sick days leave per year.
* Public holidays as declared by local government.
* Maternity leave as per law.
* Health and Life Insurance.

**Axi's interview journey**

* Talent Acquisition Interview (45 minutes)
* Hiring Manager Interview (45–60 minutes)
* Stakeholder / Cross-functional Round (30 minutes)
* Case Study (60 minutes)
* Skip Level / Executive Interview (30 minutes)

Please note that our organization works with recruitment agencies on a pre-approved basis only. A recruitment agency that wishes to submit candidate profiles or resumes for consideration must obtain prior written consent from our talent acquisition team. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, and we will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Should we receive an unsolicited resume from a recruitment agency that does not have prior written consent, we will not be responsible for the payment of any fees related to the recruitment of the candidate represented in the unsolicited resume.

At Axi, we prioritize creating a workplace that upholds fairness and respect for all. We encourage every individual within our community to contribute towards a culture where everyone feels a sense of belonging and is treated with the dignity they deserve. We make all employment-related decisions—whether in hiring, compensation, training, performance reviews, or termination—based on merit and without bias, ensuring equal opportunities for everyone. We consciously work to identify and overcome any unconscious biases, with a commitment to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee and candidate feels genuinely welcomed and valued.

job_description:
Senior Technical Product ManagerThis role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

In the **Finance and Corporate Strategy** team we ensure that the business’s capital strategies are operationally supported and strategically focused. This is how we work to secure the greatest return on investment for the global company. By gathering and analysing financial data we can influence decisions within the business, drive initiatives, and help ensure alignment with our wider objectives. Join us redefine what’s next for you.

***Job Family Definition:***

Designs, develops, troubleshoots and debugs software programs for software enhancements and new products. Develops software including operating systems, compilers, routers, networks, utilities, databases and Internet-related tools. Determines hardware compatibility and/or influences hardware design.

***Management Level Definition:***

Contributions have visible technical impact on a product or major subcomponent. Applies in-depth professional knowledge and innovative ideas to solve complex problems. Visible contributions improve time-to-market, achieve cost reductions, or satisfy current and future unmet customer needs. Recognized internal authority on key technology area applying innovative principles and ideas. Provides technical leadership for significant project/program work. Leads or participates in cross-functional initiatives and contributes to mentorship and knowledge sharing across the organization.

**What you’ll do:**

***Responsibilities:***

* Develops organization-wide architectures and methodologies for software systems design and development across multiple platforms and organizations within the Global Business Unit.
* Identifies and evaluates new technologies, innovations, and outsourced development partner relationships for alignment with technology roadmap and business value; creates plans for integration and update into architecture.
* Own the Alfred 2.0 technical roadmap, backlog, priorities, and release sequencing.
* Translate CFO and Finance needs into BRDs, use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain an end-to-end understanding of the solution architecture, data flows, integrations, and environments.
* Lead HPE readiness for required data, including source-system dependencies, transformation requirements, reconciliation, access, and availability.
* Coordinate dependencies and clarify ownership across Deloitte, HPE IT, Finance, data-platform teams, and source-system owners.
* Ensure Deloitte’s front-end designs align with available data, approved requirements, HPE architecture, security, identity, and integration standards.
* Lead technical design reviews, evaluate solution tradeoffs, and document architecture and product decisions.
* Drive release readiness across data, APIs, environments, testing, security, business acceptance, and operational support.
* Maintain visibility to technical debt and establish plans for vendor transition, knowledge transfer, and sustainable HPE ownership.
* Complete structured knowledge transfer before the current PM transitions from the program.

**What you need to bring:**

***Education and Experience Required:***

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
* Typically 10+ years experience.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

* Experience designing and developing software systems design tools and languages.
* Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.
* Experience in overall architecture of software systems for products and solutions.
* Designing and integrating software systems running on multiple platform types into overall architecture.
* Evaluating and selecting forms and processes for software systems testing and methodology, including writing and execution of test plans, debugging, and testing scripts and tools.
* History of innovation with multiple patents or deployed solutions in the field of software design.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.
* Ability to effectively communicate product architectures, design proposals and negotiate options at business unit and executive levels
* **Required Skills and Capabilities**
  ====================================

  + Strong technical product management, platform leadership, and requirements-management capabilities.
  + Ability to translate executive and Finance priorities into implementable technical requirements.
  + Working knowledge of modern cloud data platforms, data architectures, APIs, integrations, identity, security, and cloud environments.
  + Experience coordinating data readiness across multiple source systems and technical teams.
  + Ability to lead technical design discussions and challenge internal and vendor assumptions.
  + Strong stakeholder management across Finance, IT, architects, engineers, and systems integrators.
  + Clear executive communication and disciplined documentation skills. .

**Accessibility**

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health & Wellbeing**

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal & Professional Development**

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

**Let's Stay Connected:**

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Staff Technical Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

Responsible for defining and driving the product strategy, vision, and roadmap for GE HealthCare's Software Builder Tools (SBT) portfolio. Operating in close partnership with engineering, architecture, compliance, security, and product leadership teams, this role identifies the highest-value opportunities to improve software delivery, developer experience, platform engineering capabilities, DevSecOps, compliance automation, and AI-enabled software lifecycle management.  
  
The Product Manager serves as the voice of engineering customers and platform consumers across GE HealthCare, translating business and technology needs into a clear product direction, measurable outcomes, and prioritized investments. This leader balances innovation, customer value, platform adoption, operational excellence, technical sustainability, and regulatory requirements while ensuring alignment across Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Security, Quality, Compliance, and Business stakeholders.  
  
Success in this role is measured not only by feature delivery, but by improvements in developer productivity, delivery performance, platform adoption, compliance automation, software quality, and customer outcomes.  
  
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

In this role, you will:

* Define and own the long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Software Builder Tools (SBT) portfolio, ensuring alignment with GE HealthCare's software delivery, compliance, platform engineering, and AI-enabled SDLC objectives.
* Develop a deep understanding of software engineering, DevSecOps, platform engineering, compliance, developer experience, and regulated medical software development practices.
* Act as the primary voice of customers and internal engineering organizations by conducting continuous discovery, user research, listening sessions, VOC activities, interviews, and usage analysis to understand unmet needs and opportunities.
* Partner closely with engineering teams across the organization to understand delivery challenges, developer productivity barriers, compliance pain points, and platform modernization opportunities.
* Translate strategic business and engineering needs into clear product outcomes, value propositions, roadmaps, epics, features, and user stories.
* Lead portfolio prioritization decisions across platform capabilities including CI/CD, release automation, continuous testing, developer experience, compliance automation, SOUP/SBOM management, infrastructure automation, observability, AI-assisted software delivery, and engineering metrics.
* Drive product investments based on measurable customer outcomes, engineering productivity improvements, delivery performance metrics, platform utilization, and compliance effectiveness.
* Establish and monitor success metrics such as deployment frequency, lead time, pipeline performance, release cycle time, compliance cycle time, developer satisfaction, platform adoption, and operational efficiency.
* Build compelling business cases and data-driven recommendations to influence investment priorities, product strategy, and portfolio decisions.
* Own and continuously refine the product backlog, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives while balancing customer needs, technical debt, platform reliability, compliance requirements, and operational priorities.
* Work closely with Architecture, Security, Quality, Compliance, and Engineering leaders to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned to enterprise standards.
* Partner with engineering leadership to define product increments, quarterly objectives, and release priorities that maximize customer value and organizational impact.
* Facilitate product discovery, roadmap reviews, design sessions, backlog refinement, and stakeholder alignment activities across a broad and diverse set of customers.
* Champion platform adoption by identifying onboarding friction, supporting migration strategies, and improving customer engagement models to maximize successful outcomes.
* Drive innovation opportunities related to AI-enabled software development lifecycle capabilities, engineering intelligence, compliance automation, and developer productivity tooling.
* Operate as a thought leader for platform engineering and developer experience practices, helping shape the future of software delivery across GE HealthCare.
* Mentor Product Managers, TPMs, Product Owners, and other product leaders on product discovery, outcome-based planning, backlog management, and Agile product management practices.
* Influence executive stakeholders through clear communication, strategic storytelling, data-driven insights, and well-articulated product strategies.
* Demonstrate expert-level Agile Product Management capabilities and serve as a coach for outcome-oriented product development and continuous customer discovery.

**Education Qualification**

  

* Engineering Degree with significant experience in Cloud SaaS or IaaS products.

**Technical Expertise:**

  

* Solid understanding of software engineering, platform engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, cloud technologies, and developer productivity tools.
* Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and translate complex technical concepts into business value and customer outcomes.
* Experience leveraging metrics and data to drive product decisions and measure adoption, effectiveness, and impact.

**Business Acumen**

* Strong product discovery, prioritization, and roadmap planning skills with a focus on customer and business outcomes.
* Ability to balance customer needs, technical debt, compliance requirements, and strategic investments.
* Data-driven decision maker with experience developing business cases and influencing investment priorities.

**Leadership**

* Proven ability to influence without authority and align diverse stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Compliance.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity, focus, and execution.
* Strong communicator who can articulate vision, strategy, and outcomes at all levels of the organization.

**Personal Attributes**

* Customer-obsessed with a passion for improving developer experience and software delivery outcomes.
* Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving and systems-thinking capabilities.
* Curious, adaptable, and continuously learning, with a focus on innovation and continuous improvement.

**Inclusion and Diversity**

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Our **total rewards** are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

**#EveryRoleIsVital**

**#LI-SM1**

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes
