**Roles and Responsibilities:**

In this role, you will:

* Define and own the long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Software Builder Tools (SBT) portfolio, ensuring alignment with GE HealthCare's software delivery, compliance, platform engineering, and AI-enabled SDLC objectives.
* Develop a deep understanding of software engineering, DevSecOps, platform engineering, compliance, developer experience, and regulated medical software development practices.
* Act as the primary voice of customers and internal engineering organizations by conducting continuous discovery, user research, listening sessions, VOC activities, interviews, and usage analysis to understand unmet needs and opportunities.
* Partner closely with engineering teams across the organization to understand delivery challenges, developer productivity barriers, compliance pain points, and platform modernization opportunities.
* Translate strategic business and engineering needs into clear product outcomes, value propositions, roadmaps, epics, features, and user stories.
* Lead portfolio prioritization decisions across platform capabilities including CI/CD, release automation, continuous testing, developer experience, compliance automation, SOUP/SBOM management, infrastructure automation, observability, AI-assisted software delivery, and engineering metrics.
* Drive product investments based on measurable customer outcomes, engineering productivity improvements, delivery performance metrics, platform utilization, and compliance effectiveness.
* Establish and monitor success metrics such as deployment frequency, lead time, pipeline performance, release cycle time, compliance cycle time, developer satisfaction, platform adoption, and operational efficiency.
* Build compelling business cases and data-driven recommendations to influence investment priorities, product strategy, and portfolio decisions.
* Own and continuously refine the product backlog, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives while balancing customer needs, technical debt, platform reliability, compliance requirements, and operational priorities.
* Work closely with Architecture, Security, Quality, Compliance, and Engineering leaders to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned to enterprise standards.
* Partner with engineering leadership to define product increments, quarterly objectives, and release priorities that maximize customer value and organizational impact.
* Facilitate product discovery, roadmap reviews, design sessions, backlog refinement, and stakeholder alignment activities across a broad and diverse set of customers.
* Champion platform adoption by identifying onboarding friction, supporting migration strategies, and improving customer engagement models to maximize successful outcomes.
* Drive innovation opportunities related to AI-enabled software development lifecycle capabilities, engineering intelligence, compliance automation, and developer productivity tooling.
* Operate as a thought leader for platform engineering and developer experience practices, helping shape the future of software delivery across GE HealthCare.
* Mentor Product Managers, TPMs, Product Owners, and other product leaders on product discovery, outcome-based planning, backlog management, and Agile product management practices.
* Influence executive stakeholders through clear communication, strategic storytelling, data-driven insights, and well-articulated product strategies.
* Demonstrate expert-level Agile Product Management capabilities and serve as a coach for outcome-oriented product development and continuous customer discovery.

**Education Qualification**

  

* Engineering Degree with significant experience in Cloud SaaS or IaaS products.

**Technical Expertise:**

  

* Solid understanding of software engineering, platform engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, cloud technologies, and developer productivity tools.
* Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and translate complex technical concepts into business value and customer outcomes.
* Experience leveraging metrics and data to drive product decisions and measure adoption, effectiveness, and impact.

**Business Acumen**

* Strong product discovery, prioritization, and roadmap planning skills with a focus on customer and business outcomes.
* Ability to balance customer needs, technical debt, compliance requirements, and strategic investments.
* Data-driven decision maker with experience developing business cases and influencing investment priorities.

**Leadership**

* Proven ability to influence without authority and align diverse stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Compliance.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity, focus, and execution.
* Strong communicator who can articulate vision, strategy, and outcomes at all levels of the organization.

**Personal Attributes**

* Customer-obsessed with a passion for improving developer experience and software delivery outcomes.
* Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving and systems-thinking capabilities.
* Curious, adaptable, and continuously learning, with a focus on innovation and continuous improvement.

**Inclusion and Diversity**

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Our **total rewards** are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

job_description:
**What Cognite is:****Relentless****to achieve**
================================================

Cognite operates at the forefront of **industrial digitalization, building AI**, and data solutions that solve the world's hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you'll feel right at home here.

Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

**How you'll demonstrate Ownership**
------------------------------------

Are you a visionary Principal Product Manager eager to define the vision, build, and lead the development of intuitive user experiences and robust backend systems that transform industrial operations? At Cognite, we're not just building software; we're pioneering the future of industrial data with our award-winning Cognite Data Fusion® platform, recognized as the 2022 Technology Innovation Leader for Global Digital Industrial Platforms.

Our Product team is at the core of developing Cognite Data Fusion® into a robust and scalable platform for solving critical industrial data problems. This work is central to transforming asset-intensive industries – making them safer, more sustainable, and more profitable. Cognite Data Fusion® makes operational data available at scale, adding immense value through advanced data processing. This empowers industries to make truly data-driven decisions. Our platform leverages many different technologies, each chosen for its ability to solve specific challenges effectively.

To build the best possible product, we believe in autonomous teams where product managers, developers, and designers work closely together. Our teams are focused on building the next-generation industrial data platform and applications across diverse industries like Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, and Power & Utility. This includes enabling all types of workflows, from advanced analytics to assisting in critical decision-making. We're a strong mix of product managers, engineers, and designers, united by a deep commitment to user experience and creating products users genuinely want to use.

Our work environment is exciting, dynamic, and intense. You'll collaborate with top-tier domain and industry experts and business leaders. We support one another, ask incisive questions, and give constructive feedback. Our goal is to leverage our diverse strengths and backgrounds to build innovative products, think outside the ordinary, and nurture a truly great culture.

**The Impact you bring to Cognite**
-----------------------------------

As a Principal Product Manager, you'll be a key player in setting product direction, building the product, and owning its success across Cognite's industrial customers. You'll have the opportunity to:

* You love making users happy and are committed to creating products they truly want to use.
* You have a user-centric mindset: A genuine passion for understanding user needs and designing intuitive, easy-to-use solutions for complex technical problems.
* You have experience managing feature delivery and tradeoffs for a complex product area.
* You excel at communicating with different types of stakeholders, ranging from customer senior executives to technical engineers and data scientists.
* You articulate clear and well-structured product requirement documentation that sets the direction for engineering and design.
* You have a track record of successful product launches involving AI technologies.
* You're comfortable learning about new developments within the AI space, and use these tools actively yourself for working efficiently.
* You're accustomed to working in an English-speaking environment.
* You have experience mentoring junior colleagues and leading complex product development projects across global teams.
* You have leadership potential: While initially an individual contributor, you should have the ambition and capability to grow into a leadership role, potentially building and leading a team of product managers in India.
* You have 10+ years of experience in SaaS product management roles, ideally within the industrial OT and IT space, with a strong understanding of how industrial data is collected, stored, and utilised.

**Learn more about us**

  

* Impact 2025
* Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot
* We're globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi.

***Equal Opportunity***

*Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.*

title: Product Owner
job_description:
**Job Description:**

**About the Team-**

It is a transverse team working with different core engineering verticals in Airbus. The USP of this team is working in multi-functional environment providing digital solutions to engineering problems.

The USP of the team is people with Core Engineering domain knowledge complemented by software development skills. The team plays an enabler role in various digitization initiatives across Airbus utilizing latest technologies and the domain knowledge they have.

Some examples of the digital solutions for various Core Engineering departments such as Data driven designs of wiring, automated routing electrical harnesses, Data Analytics based product aimed at reducing physical tests of material specimens. It also involve developing web-based solutions to encapsulate and automate different workflows such flight test planning etc. In addition to these points, developing tools for Electrical Wiring Harness and Hydraulic Circuit design process improvements. Some of the tools developed; are used in the areas of Aircraft Safety analysis and Engineering Business Data monitoring etc.

M&T is also deeply involved in Agile Scrum and SAFe in developing state of the art digital products for the areas mentioned above.

About the Role-

We are looking for a Product Owner who comes from a software development background. You will own the team backlog for an Agile team operating within an Agile Release Train (ART), and you will do it as someone who has written production code, sat through releases, and understands what a story actually costs to build.

This is deliberately a technical Product Owner role. We are not looking for a pure business analyst or a scrum administrator. We want someone who can sit with engineers, read the design, challenge an estimate on its merits, and still hold a credible conversation with stakeholders about value and priority.

You will be the voice of the customer inside the team and the single point of decision on what gets built next.

**Experience:** 8+ Years

**What you'll do-**

  

Own the team backlog

  

* Create, refine and prioritise the team backlog so there is always at least two iterations of ready work

* Break features handed down from Product Management into user stories and technical enablers with clear acceptance criteria

* Sequence work based on value, dependencies, technical risk and capacity and be able to explain the sequence to anyone who asks

* Make informed calls on technical debt and enabler work, because you understand what it buys the team Drive the SAFe cadence

* Represent the team at PI Planning: contribute to planning objectives, negotiate scope, surface and resolve dependencies with other teams on the train

* Run backlog refinement and participate in Iteration Planning, Iteration Review, System Demo and Inspect & Adapt

* Work alongside the Scrum Master / Team Coach, Product Management, the RTE and the System Architect to keep the team aligned with ART priorities Accept the work

* Be the sole accepter of stories against defined acceptance criteria and the Definition of Done

* Validate what was built against what was intended, including non-functional requirements performance, security, maintainability

* Provide fast, unambiguous answers to the team during the iteration; unblocking is a core part of the job, not an interruption Represent the customer and the stakeholders

* Gather input from users, business stakeholders and support/operations, and translate it into backlog items

* Keep stakeholders informed on progress, trade-offs and changes no surprises at the demo

* Push back, with reasoning, when scope requests threaten quality or committed PI objectives

  

**Skills Needed-**

  

Essential:

* Software development life cycle: a solid, practical understanding of the full SDLC requirements, design,

development, testing, release and maintenance and how decisions early in the cycle play out later

* Object-oriented development: hands-on experience building software in at least one of Java, C++ or C#

* Front-end technologies: working experience with front-end frameworks and libraries such as Angular,

jQuery, Ext JS or Node.js

* Demonstrable experience as a Product Owner in a scaled Agile setup (SAFe, or an equivalent multi-team

model such as LeSS or Nexus)

* Practical, first-hand participation in PI Planning and the full SAFe iteration cadence not just theoretical

familiarity

* Strong story writing: clear acceptance criteria, INVEST-shaped stories, well-defined enablers

* Confidence prioritising with an explicit method (WSJF, cost of delay, or similar) and defending those

decisions to senior stakeholders

* Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including counterparts in [Europe / other regions]

* Excellent written and verbal communication in English

* Fluency with backlog and collaboration tooling Jira / Azure DevOps, Confluence

  

**Preferred:**

* Aerospace domain experience exposure to aerospace or aviation programmes, systems or regulatory

context

* SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager (POPM) certification, or willingness to certify within the first six

months

* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control workflows and automated testing practices

* Exposure to data-informed product decisions: defining metrics, reading them, and changing course based on

them

* Experience transitioning from an engineering role into product ownership

  

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

**Company:**

Airbus India Private Limited

**Employment Type:**

Permanent

-

**Experience Level:**

Professional

**Job Family:**

Programme & Project Management <JF-PP-PM>

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
  
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com .

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager, AI
job_description:
**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will serve as a Senior Product Manager for Teradata's vector search and unstructured data capabilities, driving product vision, strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption. You will define how enterprises turn documents, images, audio, and other unstructured content into searchable, trusted context that AI applications and agents can retrieve at scale, alongside the structured data they already manage in Teradata.

On the retrieval side, you will own the product direction for vector and hybrid search: indexing and approximate nearest neighbor techniques, filtering, ranking and re-ranking, and the balance between recall, latency, freshness, and cost. You will work with engineering to make vector search a first-class, SQL-native capability that performs at enterprise scale and concurrency, and you will define how relevance and quality are measured, not only how fast queries run.

On the ingestion side, you will own how unstructured data gets into the platform: connectors to object stores and enterprise content sources, document parsing, OCR, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental refresh. You will shape pipelines that are reliable, governed, and cost-efficient, with access controls, lineage, and sensitive-data handling that carry through from source to retrieved result.

Your impact will be measured by customers moving from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) prototypes to production AI applications and agents that run on trusted enterprise data, with measurable gains in answer quality, time to value, and cost per query.

**Who You Will Work With**

You will collaborate with customers, engineering, the database engine and SQL teams, AI platform and data science teams, cloud infrastructure, UX, governance and security, product marketing, and field teams to bring next-generation retrieval capabilities into Teradata's enterprise ecosystem. You will be responsible for ensuring our products meet business objectives.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from a recognized institution. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

* 6+ years of experience in software product development companies, including 3+ years in product management working with AI/ML, search, or data platform products.

* Strong knowledge of embeddings and vector search, including index types (such as HNSW and IVF), quantization, filtered and hybrid search (keyword plus vector), and re-ranking.

* Working understanding of RAG, LLMs, and AI agents, and how retrieval quality drives answer quality. Experience defining evaluation metrics such as recall, precision, and relevance.

* Understanding of unstructured data ingestion: document parsing, OCR, chunking strategies, multimodal content, metadata extraction, and embedding pipelines, including GPU considerations.

* Experience with data pipelines and connectors on cloud object storage, including batch and incremental or streaming ingestion.

* Experience with APIs, SDKs, and integrations for enterprise and developer adoption, including open ecosystems such as Python, Jupyter, and agent frameworks.

* Familiarity with the competitive landscape, such as Pinecone, Elasticsearch and OpenSearch, pgvector, Snowflake, Databricks, and MongoDB, and the ability to benchmark against it.

* Excellent communication skills, with a strong track record of customer engagement, product KPIs, and prioritization.

* Experience with AI productivity tools, and the ability to work independently and deliver high quality outcomes in fast-paced environments.

**What You Will Bring**

* Experience building search, retrieval, or data ingestion products at scale, with a clear view of the trade-offs between recall, latency, freshness, and cost.

* Hands-on exposure to building RAG applications or agents on structured and unstructured enterprise data.

* A quality mindset: the discipline to build benchmarks and evaluation sets, and to let data decide between approaches.

* A strong understanding of responsible AI, including explainability, auditability, and protection of sensitive data in retrieval.

* Vision to anticipate how agents will use retrieval, and to position Teradata's offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.

* Passion for intuitive developer and user experiences, such as natural language search and simple, SQL-friendly interfaces.

* Ability to influence engineering and go-to-market teams without direct authority, and to mentor others.

#LI-NM1

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

**What You Will Bring**

* Experience building search, retrieval, or data ingestion products at scale, with a clear view of the trade-offs between recall, latency, freshness, and cost.

* Hands-on exposure to building RAG applications or agents on structured and unstructured enterprise data.

* A quality mindset: the discipline to build benchmarks and evaluation sets, and to let data decide between approaches.

* A strong understanding of responsible AI, including explainability, auditability, and protection of sensitive data in retrieval.

* Vision to anticipate how agents will use retrieval, and to position Teradata's offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.

* Passion for intuitive developer and user experiences, such as natural language search and simple, SQL-friendly interfaces.

* Ability to influence engineering and go-to-market teams without direct authority, and to mentor others.

#LI-NM1

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: Principal Product Manager
job_description:
**About Target:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.

**About Team & Role:**

Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.

Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.

As a Principal Product Manager, you will shape the strategic vision and own the roadmap for a complex product domain. You will partner with Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams to establish short- and long-term goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The Principal Product Manager based in India is a strategic senior individual contributor who serves as a force multiplier across product strategy, platform evolution, and AI transformation within Target’s Service Centre product ecosystem. This role provides strategic product leadership across business and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions. The Principal Product Manager will shape the long-term evolution of Digital Servicing, AI-enabled experiences, operational platforms, and enterprise insight capabilities serving Guests, team members, partners, and business functions. The role partners closely with the Director of Product Management to transform core servicing capabilities and accelerate the responsible adoption of AI, automation, and intelligent experiences.

**Detailed Job Description:**

Success in this role is demonstrated through the ability to shape the long-term evolution of Digital Servicing, elevate product management maturity, influence enterprise priorities without direct authority, and deliver measurable improvements in Guest experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. The Principal Product Manager is a strategic thought leader, trusted partner, mentor, and force multiplier who accelerates product excellence across the TES portfolio.

**Strategic Product Leadership**

* Establish a clear multi-year vision and roadmap for Digital Servicing, AI-powered experiences, and servicing platforms.
* Influence product investment decisions to align with TES and enterprise priorities.
* Translate complex business challenges into scalable product opportunities with measurable outcomes.

**Business and Product Outcomes**

* Improve servicing outcomes across Guest experience, team member productivity, operational efficiency, adoption, automation, and cost to serve.
* Deliver measurable progress against product OKRs and enterprise priorities.
* Ensure product investments generate measurable business value rather than technology outputs alone.

**Product Maturity and Capability Building**

* Elevate product management practices across discovery, experimentation, prioritisation, roadmap development, measurement, and storytelling.
* Coach and mentor product practitioners, strengthening customer-centric problem-solving and outcome-based decision-making.
* Establish consistent product discipline and effective product-management practices across TES teams.

**Enterprise Influence**

* Serve as a trusted adviser to Product, Technology, Data, Design, Operations, and business leaders.
* Strengthen alignment between business strategy and product execution.
* Reduce decision-making friction and accelerate execution across organisational and functional boundaries

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of product management or equivalent domain experience, preferably within retail, consumer servicing, enterprise platforms, or AI-enabled products.
* Demonstrated experience defining strategy and roadmaps for complex, enterprise-scale products or platforms.
* Deep expertise in product discovery, experimentation, prioritisation, outcome-based roadmaps, and product measurement.
* Experience leading product-driven transformation across Technology, Data, Design, Operations, and business teams.
* Strong understanding of digital servicing, automation, AI-enabled experiences, data flows, and platform capabilities.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders without direct authority.
* Demonstrated ability to coach and mentor product practitioners and elevate product-management maturity.
* Strong strategic thinking, communication, storytelling, and data-driven decision-making skills.
* Expertise in agile product-development practices.

title: Senior Product Manager - IT Operations
job_description:
Overview:

**Working at Atlassian**

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities:

**About the role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead critical areas of IT Operations and Incident Management. You will identify the customer and business problems that make incidents difficult to detect, resolve, and learn from—and turn those insights into focused product strategy and execution.

This role will serve customers across both IT and Developer teams. You will work across the incident management journey, using a thoughtful combination of AI-powered and non-AI capabilities to improve customer outcomes, user experience, adoption, and business growth.

**What you’ll do**

* Define and execute product strategy for high-impact areas within Incident Management, impacting both IT and Developer personas
* Identify customer pain points and business opportunities across Enterprise and SMB segments through customer research, product data, support insights, and market signals.
* Prioritize opportunities that improve incident outcomes while creating meaningful value for customers and the business
* Balance AI investments with reliable non-AI capabilities, including workflow improvements, automation, integrations, collaboration tools, reporting, and operational controls.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Research, Marketing, Sales, Support, and Customer Success to deliver high-quality experiences end to end.
* Engage directly with Enterprise and SMB customers to validate problems, test concepts, understand adoption barriers, and measure impact.
* Help JSM and Service Collection grow by increasing customer value, adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion within IT Operations.

**Impact you’ll have**

* **Better incident outcomes:** Help customers reduce time to detect and resolve incidents.
* **Stronger cross-functional collaboration:** Enable IT and Developer teams to work together effectively during high-pressure events.
* **Smarter operations:** Apply AI where it meaningfully reduces effort and improves decisions, while preserving transparency, control, and trust.
* **Business growth:** Create product experiences that strengthen JSM and Service Collection’s position as a strategic platform for service and operations management.

**What we’re looking for**

* 10+ years of experience building and launching successful B2B or SaaS products as a Product Manager or equivalent.
* Strong customer empathy, for Enterprise and SMB, and a track record of turning complex customer problems into focused product strategies.
* Comfort operating in technically complex spaces and partnering closely with Engineering and Data Science.
* Practical understanding of AI-enabled product development, including when AI is appropriate and when deterministic experiences are better.
* Strong analytical skills and a focus on measurable outcomes, experimentation, adoption, and business impact.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence across teams and at senior levels.
* A bias toward action, strong product judgment, and the ability to make progress through ambiguity.

**Success in this role**

Success will mean building a clear, evidence-based strategy for specific areas within Incident Management; delivering experiences that customers trust during critical incidents; improving outcomes for both IT and Developer teams; and contributing to sustainable growth for the Service Collection.

Compensation:

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Qualifications:

**Benefits & Perks**

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits****.**

**About Atlassian**

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit **go.atlassian.com/crh****.**

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

job_description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to join our AEM (Adobe Experience Manager) team. This role plays a critical part in driving the successful delivery of digital features and enhancements by acting as the bridge between business stakeholders, design, engineering, and delivery teams.

The ideal candidate will take end-to-end ownership of features, ensuring clarity of requirements, smooth execution, and timely delivery while maintaining strong alignment with business objectives. Deep knowledge of Adobe Experience Cloud products and hands-on experience working in Agile delivery models using Azure DevOps is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and technical partners to translate business needs into well-defined functional requirements.
* Lead requirement discovery activities including stakeholder discussions, requirement walkthroughs, and solution alignment sessions to ensure a shared understanding of objectives and scope.
* Analyze business problems and digital requirements, recommending solutions that balance customer experience, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines.
* Decompose high-level initiatives into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria that enable efficient estimation, development, and testing.
* Partner closely with product owners, designers, architects, and engineers throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure alignment and continuity from concept to release.
* Support Agile ceremonies such as backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives by providing clarity on requirements and prioritization.
* Assist delivery teams during implementation by clarifying requirements, resolving functional questions, and managing scope-related discussions.
* Monitor progress of assigned initiatives to identify risks, dependencies, and potential delivery challenges, driving timely resolution.
* Validate completed functionality through acceptance testing to ensure solutions meet business expectations and defined success criteria.
* Support stakeholder reviews, sprint demonstrations, and release readiness activities by articulating functionality and business value.
* Facilitate final handoff of completed initiatives to business stakeholders, ensuring proper documentation, alignment, and formal approval.
* Assess stakeholder feedback to determine enhancements, defect remediation, or change requests and initiate appropriate follow-up actions.
* Maintain end-to-end accountability for assigned features or initiatives, ensuring transparency, traceability, and effective communication throughout the lifecycle.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Experience & Domain Knowledge**

* 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst/Product Owner in digital or enterprise technology programs.
* Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
* Working knowledge is preferred of Adobe Experience Cloud, including products such as:
  + AEM Assets
  + AEMaaCS
  + Workfront
  + Adobe Target etc
* Experience working in Agile / Scrum environments.

**Tools & Methodologies**

* Proficiency with Azure DevOps for feature and backlog management.
* Experience with user story writing, backlog grooming, and sprint planning ceremonies.
* Familiarity with design handoffs, UX workflows, and component-based development.

**Core Competencies**

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity.
* High ownership mindset with attention to detail.
* Comfortable working across cross-functional, distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in large-scale enterprise or multi-team Agile programs.
* Exposure to CMS-driven, personalization, or content-led digital platforms.
* Prior experience supporting website platforms with frequent releases.

**Posting Dates:**

October 6, 2026 - October 19, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Keet (100% Remote)
job_description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a **Senior Technical Product Manager** to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

**Responsibilities**

**Vision & Strategy**

* Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.
* Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.
* Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

**Technical Product Leadership**

* Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.
* Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.
* Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.
* Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

**Rapid Prototyping with AI**

* Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

job_description:
**About the role and team**
  
  
Product at Uber means making big decisions without perfect information-and owning the outcomes. As a Senior Product Manager (Tech), you will turn massive complexity into clarity at speed, navigating the "messy" reality of multi-sided marketplaces and high-stakes technical integrations. You will be at the heart of our most ambitious missions, architecting solutions that bridge the digital and physical worlds for millions of users globally.
  
  
Our Team's vision is to build a Global Payment Compliance Platform to support Uber's growth and expansion, while meeting regulatory obligations. As a Senior Product Manager on the Payments Compliance Platform team, you'll be at the forefront of building a world-class compliance platform for all Payments Methods, Products and User Personas in Global Markets. This role is also critical to enable faster scaling of Uber's Global Business while navigating the complex and ever-changing landscape of financial regulations and compliance standards .
  
  
**What you'll do**

* Define long term vision for charter with Product Leadership focused on New Opportunities and evolving landscape of Global financial regulations and User Needs.
* Build & evolve core capabilities such as KYB (Know your Business), KYC (Know your customer), PRRM (Partner Risk Rating Model), EDD (Enhanced Due Diligence), ODD(Ongoing Due Diligence), etc. leveraging AI as needed & driving automation.
* Partner with key stakeholders such as Compliance Officers , Comm Ops Leads, Legal, Payments and Operations teams and convert them into Product Requirements.
* Define and prioritise a detailed product roadmap balancing Regulatory Needs, User requirements & Business Growth.
* Align Leadership & cross-org. product teams on Core problems and Influence cross-org. product roadmap collaborating with them for roadmap execution.
* Collaborate and Communicate with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Design, Data science, Data Engineering, ML, TPM, Compliance Operations & Business Operations to build & deliver high-impact products.
* Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation/feature definition to launch and post-launch feedback & improvements

**Basic Qualifications**

* 7 + years of experience as a Product Manager
* Experience in compliance, regulatory products with strong understanding of compliance Modules & Processes (e.g. AML, KYC, ODD, EDD, Screening, etc.)
* Define and prioritise a detailed product roadmap balancing Regulatory Needs, User requirements & Business Growth.
* Strong technical depth: Able to coordinate large engineering efforts, identify potential technical risks, and act as an effective partner for engineering managers across teams.
* Experience defining OKRs and roadmaps for complex programs/platforms, ensuring teams operate with minimal noise and a rapid clip of high-quality delivery.
* Collaborate and Communicate with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Design, Data science, Data Engineering, ML, TPM, Compliance Operations & Business Operations to build & deliver high-impact products
* Experience representing significant areas of work to executives to gather feedback, generate alignment, and garner support.
* Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related technical/quantitative field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Has built & managed Internal/Enterprise Platforms at a global scale
Global experience: Building and launching products that bridge digital and physical worlds across diverse regional contexts.  

  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Principal Lead- Product Owner
job_description:
**About Our Company**

Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.

Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**

The Enterprise Architecture Product Owner is responsible for managing and evolving the Enterprise Architecture operating model, products, governance processes, work management practices, and knowledge repositories. The role serves as the central coordination point for architecture planning, execution tracking, governance, process maturity, documentation standards, reporting, and continuous improvement. This role requires close collaboration with Enterprise Architects and Technology Leaders to improve adoption of architecture standards, governance processes, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps  
  
The individual drives consistent adoption of architecture processes maintains operational discipline across architecture teams, and drives transparency through effective governance, metrics, Jira management, and executive reporting.  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong product ownership, program management, and Agile delivery expertise with a solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture practices and governance. They are highly organized, process-driven, and experienced in Jira and Confluence administration, Scrum and Kanban methodologies, backlog management, story-point estimation, executive reporting, and documentation governance. The individual will drive operational excellence, process maturity, transparency, and adoption across the Enterprise Architecture function.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap, backlog, adoption strategy, and operational metrics for Enterprise Architecture products, services, and governance capabilities.
* Define, document, govern, and continuously improve Enterprise Architecture processes, standards, workflows, templates, and operating procedures.
* Serve as the owner of the Enterprise Architecture operating model, ensuring consistent execution of architecture governance, planning, review, and lifecycle management processes.
* Manage architecture work intake, prioritization, planning, capacity management, and execution tracking across the Enterprise Architecture team.
* Act as the Jira and Confluence subject matter expert, administering workflows, automations, dashboards, reporting, templates, and knowledge repositories.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices, including backlog management, story creation, story-point estimation, sprint planning, Kanban flow management, and milestone tracking.
* Establish and maintain architecture documentation standards, architecture artifacts, governance records, and knowledge repositories to ensure information is accurate, current, and accessible.
* Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and reports that provide visibility into architecture demand, priorities, capacity, risks, dependencies, progress, and business outcomes.
* Facilitate architecture governance forums, architecture reviews, planning sessions, retrospectives, and cross-functional working sessions.
* Drive accountability for maintaining accurate work items, status updates, milestones, architecture artifacts, and governance records within Jira and Confluence.
* Establish and track KPIs, maturity metrics, adoption measures, and performance indicators to assess the effectiveness of Enterprise Architecture services and governance practices.
* Prepare executive presentations, leadership communications, governance updates, status reports, and decision-support materials.
* Identify and implement process improvements, automation opportunities, and AI-enabled capabilities that enhance architecture planning, governance, reporting, documentation, and operational efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 12+ years of overall experience in technology program management, Agile delivery, PMO, delivery management, or related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience as a Program Manager, Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, or similar role within a technology organization.
* Strong practical experience with Jira administration, including workflow configuration, automation, dashboards, filters, and reporting.
* Experience coordinating work across multiple teams and driving accountability without direct reporting authority.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder-management, and follow-up skills.
* Experience preparing executive dashboards, leadership presentations, status reporting, and decision-support materials.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain attention to detail, and operate effectively with senior leaders and architects.
* Broad understanding of enterprise technology domains, including cloud, networking, security, data, platform engineering, and AI, with the ability to collaborate effectively with architects across these areas.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of AWS cloud concepts and services.
* Familiarity with Enterprise Architecture practices, governance processes, and technology portfolio management.
* Experience with Confluence, Power BI, Jira and similar collaboration and reporting tools.
* Understanding of AI productivity tools and their practical application to workflow automation, reporting, and knowledge management.
* Experience establishing governance routines and operating processes for technology teams.
* Agile, Scrum, Jira, project management, or program management certification.

**In-Office Collaboratio**n

We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2) days per week. Some roles may require additional in-office time or different in-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

**Full-Time/Part-Time**

Full time

**Timings**

(2:00p-10:30p)

**India Business Unit**

AWMPO AWMP&S President's Office

**Job Family Group**

Technology

*Ameriprise India LLP is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, genetic information, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, military status, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, family status or any other basis prohibited by law.*

*We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for individuals with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, speak to your recruiter to discuss how we can support you.*

title: Product Owner
job_description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

The Product Owner – Knowledge Management is responsible for the strategic oversight and advancement of the supply chain capabilities that enable our digital transformation. They will lead design, testing and implementation with Supply Chain teams and leverage close partnership with D&T, Finance, and 3rd parties. The role will also work across Supply Chain pillar teams and current transformation efforts to coordinate capability development and knowledge advancement. Focus areas include integration of ai capabilities, visibility tools, automation & workflow tools, smart alerts, advanced analytics and support for key initiatives. This position reports to the Sr. Manager Digital Foundations

The Product Owner – Knowledge Management plays a central role in the continued evolution of our SC Digital Literacy and Learning model by optimizing performance and identifying opportunities for value creation, while expanding the scope to our Finance, teams and SC Governance workstreams. The shift timings for the role will be **1:30 PM–10:30 PM**

**Function Overview**

The GIC Supply Chain team manages end-to-end operations, encompassing planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and analytics. They strategically plan to meet market demands, optimize sourcing, ensure efficient production, and oversee the seamless movement of goods from production to delivery. The team employs advanced analytics throughout these processes, fostering adaptability and operational excellence. This collaborative approach ensures a well-coordinated supply chain that aligns with both organizational goals and dynamic market conditions.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Develop strategic roadmap for Supply Chain Digital Capabilities to include design and implementation across platforms
* Coordination across transformation efforts.
* Develop capabilities to support Supply Chain Pillars and Segments (including ESC and Finance)
* Manage third party vendor relationships and contracts
* Prioritize capability build and implementation which includes External Benchmarking, training and documentation creation
Exploration and testing of advanced technologies for Supply Chain application (Artificial Intelligence, Smart Alerts, Automation)  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's/master’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain.

* 12+ years of related experience in Supply chain, Business and Digital transformation projects, Product ownership

* Proven project management skills

* Experience working with third parties and global partners

* Supply Chain knowledge with experience partnering with D&T organization

* Successful change management background

**Skills & Abilities:**

* Proven project management skills

* Experience working with third parties and global partners.

* Strong leadership skills, including the ability to drive change

* Strong influence skills and ability to influence across functions and business strategies

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills

* Strong organizational and people development skills

* Able to lead and direct cross functional team members

* Self-managing, results oriented and capable of leading multiple initiatives simultaneously

* Able to enter uncertain/ambiguous situations, assess opportunities, identify stakeholders, and bring direction to a project, take action, and deliver results

* Strong analytical thinking and creative problem solving

* Ability to work in global multi-cultural teams (global organizations/MNCs)

* Demonstrated high level of learning & cultural agility.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Preferred Degree Requirements: Masters
* Preferred Major Area of Study: Operations Supply Chain
* Preferred Professional Certifications: CPIM/CSCP
* Preferred years of related experience: 1-2 years

**Development Candidate Will Receive in Role**

* End-to-End Supply Chain experience
* Vendor management and contract management
* Finance – budget creation and oversight
* Leading a Global Digital program
* Executive Communication – partnering with SC Pillar Leaders
* Service management mindset & capabilities

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Product Manager - Liquidity & Account Solutions Product Development - Vice President
job_description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Shape the future of global liquidity by helping deliver modern, client-first capabilities at scale. Join a team where you will partner across product, technology, and operations to turn complex needs into delivered outcomes. Bring your product and analysis expertise to a role with strong visibility, growth opportunities, and mobility across a global payments organization.

As a Product Vice President at JPMorganChase within Payments, Liquidity and Account Solutions Product Development, you will drive delivery of money market fund capabilities as part of a multi-year liquidity platform transformation. You will act as a primary liaison between product owners and technology delivery teams to define clear requirements and enable predictable execution. You will translate current-state behaviors and client needs into a prioritized backlog of features, user stories, and acceptance criteria. You will partner with engineering, operations, user experience, and business stakeholders to deliver agreed milestones with strong quality and risk discipline. You will help ensure solutions are scalable, user-friendly, and aligned to evolving market and regulatory expectations.

This role supports a global initiative modernizing liquidity and account services for large multinational corporate and financial institution clients. The work spans multiple regions and stakeholder groups and requires strong coordination across product, technology, and operational partners. You will help close current-state gaps while defining a clear target state that supports faster product innovation and improved client experience. Success will be measured through delivery of prioritized capabilities, clarity of documentation, and effective stakeholder alignment. Coverage flexibility is required to support United States business hours through 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with occasional extension based on critical delivery needs.

Job Responsibilities

* **Develop** deep domain knowledge of liquidity and money market fund offerings, including client workflows, constraints, and value drivers.
* **Lead** cross-functional execution across product, engineering, operations, and regional stakeholders to deliver committed milestones.
* **Analyze** existing processes and documentation to understand current-state behavior and identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* **Define** target-state requirements using clear artifacts such as epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.

**LOCATION:** Pune / India | **COMPANY:** Knorr-Bremse Technology Center India Private Limited | **REQUISITION ID:** 11097 | Full-time | Regular

| **ON-SITE/REMOTE:** On-site

**Position Summary**

The Associate Product Manager will support the Trailer Product Management team in managing the product portfolio across its lifecycle. The role acts as a key interface between Product Managers, Product Owners, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Purchasing, Sales, Quality, and Finance to ensure effective execution of product changes, VaVe initiatives, portfolio optimization, ramp-up monitoring, and lifecycle-related activities.

The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, collaborative, and comfortable working across global and regional teams. The role requires strong ownership, process discipline, and the ability to translate portfolio data into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Lifecycle & Portfolio Management**

* Support Product Managers in managing the complete product lifecycle from market introduction through phase-out and end-of-life.
* Maintain portfolio overviews and support portfolio optimization activities focused on profitability, complexity reduction, and strategic fit.
* Coordinate phase-in, phase-out, and ramp-up tracking activities with relevant stakeholders.
* Support optimization of wiring and trailer product portfolio, including process ownership for selected portfolio adaptation topics.
* Ensure product data accuracy and maintain lifecycle-related documentation and tracking files.

**Change Management & Process Coordination**

* Coordinate and run product Change Requests (CRs) through established business and engineering change processes.
* Lead implementation of engineering and product changes across Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Sales.
* Ensure timely communication, follow-up, and escalation for product-related change topics.

**Commercial excellence**

* Support data-driven decision-making through analysis of product, sales, profitability, complexity, and lifecycle data.
* Support the VaVe pipeline and maintain a structured overview of active and potential VaVe topics.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Purchasing, Operations, and Product Management to identify value engineering and cost optimization opportunities.

**Analysis & Reporting**

* Develop and maintain reports and dashboards using Power BI, Excel, and relevant business systems.
* Analyze portfolio gaps, product performance, ramp-up status, LTB stock, and phase-in/phase-out progress.

**Cross-Functional Interface & Team Support**

* Act as an interface between Product Managers, Product Owners, Engineering, Operations, Purchasing, Supply Chain, Sales, Quality, and Finance.
* Support Global Product Managers in day-to-day portfolio management activities, stakeholder follow-up, and preparation of decision documents.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in mechanical, Electrical, Electronics Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Industrial Engineering.
* Masters degree or MBA in Product Management, Marketing, Operations, or Business Administration is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 3-4 years of experience in Product Management, Product Engineering, Project Management, Portfolio Management, Sales Engineering, or Automotive Industry roles.
* Experience in commercial vehicles, trailer systems, braking systems, wiring solutions, automotive components, or industrial manufacturing is preferred.
* Exposure to product lifecycle management, change management, VaVe, business case preparation, or portfolio optimization is desirable.

**Technical & Functional Skills**

* Understanding of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) principles and product portfolio processes.
* Experience with Change Request (CR) and engineering change management processes.
* Knowledge of Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VaVe), cost optimization, and business case development.
* Strong analytical skills with advanced Microsoft Excel capability.
* Experience with Power BI or similar data visualization tools.
* Ability to analyze product portfolio data, profitability, sales trends, product complexity, and lifecycle KPIs.
* Hands on experience with Creo with R&D background / wiring Harness experience is plus.

  

**Come and join our team in Schwieberdingen!**

Who are we? Some 32,000 team players around the world, hard at work in over 100 locations across more than 30 countries. As a force for progress on road and rail, we prioritize technical excellence, sustainable business practices and social responsibility. At the last count, our global revenues totaled EUR 7.9 billion. Responsibility and variety are hallmarks of the work you’ll be doing in an international environment with attractive working conditions – including flexible working hours, sabbaticals and remote work. In addition, you can work up to twenty days a year from abroad in the EU. A broad selection of continuing education programs offers you plenty of opportunities to develop both professionally and personally. And you can look forward to many other benefits, such as paid vacations and end-of-year bonuses, an in-house cafeteria, sports and healthcare programs, corporate volunteering, BusinessBike bicycle leasing and so much more. Come and experience the inspiring team spirit that energizes our international development network.

**Let’s shape the future of mobility together!**
