job_description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

The Retain Cloud Product Owner – Senior Associate is the dedicated product and platform owner for Retain Cloud, the firm’s resource planning and scheduling platform, within the Enterprise Applications Support team. Based in Crowe’s Hyderabad office and working closely with US-based stakeholders, this role combines hands-on administration and configuration with day-to-day product ownership: managing the Retain backlog and roadmap, translating business needs into well-defined epics and user stories, coordinating vendor releases, and driving adoption as additional business units move onto the platform.

This position takes Retain beyond break/fix support. The Product Owner partners with the Retain business owner, business unit resource management teams, the Solutions support team, and the Retain vendor to keep the platform stable, secure, and aligned with firm priorities. As Retain moves into steady-state operations, the role will also be cross-trained on other enterprise applications supported by the team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Ownership and Backlog Management:**

  

* Own the Retain Cloud product backlog in ServiceNow, capturing, refining, and prioritizing demands, epics, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
* Partner with the Retain business owner and business unit leaders to translate business goals into a product roadmap, release plan, and prioritized backlog.
* Lead requirements gathering and backlog refinement sessions, make day-to-day prioritization decisions, and escalate trade-offs that affect scope, timeline, or investment.
* Confirm that delivered changes meet the intended business need and are ready for release, coordinating user acceptance testing (UAT) with business users.
* Track adoption, data quality, and support trends to measure value and guide priorities.
* Platform Administration and Configuration
* Serve as the primary technical administrator for Retain Cloud, configuring security profiles, skills, scheduling units, booking components, dropdown values, and other system settings.
* Manage user access and role assignments through the ServiceNow access request process, and support periodic access reviews with business approvers.
* Prepare, run, and validate mass booking and other data loads in UAT and production.
* Monitor integrations and daily data feeds, including worker and skills data from Workday, and coordinate the resolution of feed and data issues.
* Maintain configuration documentation and follow the firm’s change management process.
* Release and Vendor Management
* Act as the primary liaison with the Retain vendor: log and track support cases, escalate defects, and monitor vendor SLA performance.
* Review vendor release notes, assess the impact of each Retain Cloud release, and plan and execute regression testing.
* Communicate upcoming releases, resolved issues, and new features to support teams and users, and confirm that incidents addressed in a release are closed afterward.
* Business Unit Onboarding and Adoption
* Lead configuration and readiness work for business units onboarding to Retain Cloud, including requirements, data migration and reconciliation, UAT, and cutover planning.
* oordinate the timing of changes and rollouts with business unit operations leaders to avoid busy season and filing-deadline conflicts.
* Develop training materials and job aids, and help resource managers adopt new features.
* Support and Continuous Improvement
* Serve as the Solutions-level (L3) escalation point for Retain incidents: reproduce issues in the test environment, capture diagnostics, manage problem records, and provide workarounds.
* Build and maintain the Retain knowledge base so Services and Troubleshooting teams can resolve common issues quickly and consistently.
* Analyze ticket trends to find recurring issues and drive permanent fixes or enhancements.
* Support Retain reporting needs by producing accurate scheduling and resource data for resource managers and leadership.

**Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3–5 years of experience in enterprise SaaS application administration, business systems analysis, or product ownership.
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience administering, configuring, or supporting Retain (Retain Cloud strongly preferred); deep experience with a comparable resource management platform will be considered.
* Experience supporting resource management or scheduling teams in a professional services environment (audit, tax, or consulting) preferred.
* Experience managing a backlog and writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria in ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Jira, or a similar tool.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM and ITIL practices.
* Experience with Workday or other HR system integrations and data loads is a plus.
* Product Owner certification (such as CSPO or PSPO) preferred.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.

**Requirements**

* This is a hybrid position. The selected candidate must live within commute distance of the Crowe office in Hyderabad, India, and be able to travel to the office as needed.
* Ability to work during US business hours collaborate with US-based stakeholders, with flexibility for releases, go-lives, and critical escalations.
* Estimate an annual average of 10–15% overtime. Overtime will be required to meet critical deadlines and during busy season months.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills for engaging US-based leaders.
* Ability to work independently with broad direction and little supervision while collaborating effectively across a geographically dispersed team.

**Key Positions with Which This Position Interfaces**

* Retain applications for business lead and business unit representatives
* Business unit resource managers and operations leaders
* Enterprise Applications Support Solutions team
* Services and Troubleshooting support teams
* Retain vendor support and product teams
* HR technology and data integration teams (such as Workday)
* ServiceNow platform, project management, and IT leadership teams

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  
  
**How You Can Grow:**  
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  
  
**More about Crowe:**

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

job_description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

**Team Overview**

We are seeking a Technical Product Manager who owns technical delivery and application solution outcomes for a major product area or
  
program workstream. This role partners closely with internal business resources and technical teams to analyze requirements and drive the
  
end-to-end design, development or development oversight, testing, implementation, delivery, and documentation of data processing solutions.
  
  
In this role, you will help sequence the roadmap for the next 2–3 Program Increments (PIs), ensure delivery commitments are feasible and well documented, and coordinate across scrum teams to support successful solution design, build, release, adoption, and ongoing improvement.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

**Agile & Scrum Leadership**

* Lead delivery of strategic Alternative Credit initiatives, including Alternative Data products, Blended Score capabilities, score
* deployment efforts, data provider integrations, compliance enhancements, platform modernization, and customer onboarding requirements.
* Own technical delivery and application solution execution for a major product area or program workstream; lead delivery across multiple scrum teams so requirements, solution designs, development work, testing, documentation, implementation, and release activities are sequenced, staffed, and ready for iterative delivery.
* Convert business strategy and stakeholder requirements into clear priorities, a sequenced roadmap, and actionable epics and stories; secure alignment across business, architecture, engineering, compliance, and delivery teams before commitment and maintain traceability from outcomes to requirements, user stories, releases, and supporting documentation.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies across product, engineering, analytics, operations, architecture, and support teams so plans are feasible and credible; surface risks early, coordinate mitigations across teams, and remove impediments before they become urgent.
* Escalate the right issues with clear options and trade-offs and drive timely decisions; facilitate prioritization and sequencing based on impact, feasibility, risk, and readiness.
  

**Cross Functional Program Leadership**

* Partner closely with Data Science, Analytics, Product Management, Compliance, and Engineering teams to support the development, implementation, monitoring, and evolution of Alternative and Blended Score products. Coordinate dependencies related to data acquisition, model deployment, score production, validation, operational readiness, and customer adoption.
* Drive roadmap planning and execution for the FactorTrust platform and Alternative Credit ecosystem, balancing technical debt reduction, regulatory requirements, infrastructure modernization, product enhancements, and strategic growth initiatives.
* Partner with internal business resources and technical teams in a matrixed environment—including solutions/product, engineering, architecture, UX, data science/analytics, compliance, legal, product marketing, operations, and support—to analyze requirements, align on outcomes, and coordinate delivery commitments.
* Define and maintain a roadmap for the next 2–3 PIs for your product area/workstream; influence yearly planning and coordinate cross-team sequencing and dependencies.
* Run KPI-driven reviews and adjust the plan to maximize measurable outcomes; use delivery, quality, performance, and operational signals to surface improvement opportunities and drive changes that increase customer value, improve flow, and strengthen solution resiliency.
  

**Product Development Lifecycle Ownership**

* Guide the full product and technical delivery lifecycle—from discovery through launch and iteration—ensuring readiness at each stage, including requirements analysis, solution definition, application design, development oversight, testing, delivery, release, adoption, and documentation.
* Translate customer, business, and stakeholder needs into actionable outcomes and deliverables for multiple teams, accounting for system boundaries, architecture constraints, dependencies, performance considerations, data movement,integrations, and operating model impacts.
* Own and communicate a sequenced roadmap and backlog; continually re-plan based on KPI performance, impact, feasibility, risk, and readiness while tracking medium-term risks and opportunities. Lead discovery workshops, requirements analysis, and technical solution discussions for foundational and high-visibility initiatives; evaluate options and trade-offs, align on approach, and drive end-to-end execution across teams and partner teams.
* Lead requirements definition and technical execution for credit risk products that leverage alternative data, including consumer reporting solutions, score development initiatives, prescreening capabilities, identity and fraud inputs, decisioning integrations, and customer-facing product enhancements.
* Ensure product designs and implementations support regulatory, operational, and customer requirements, including FCRA compliance, model governance standards, audit readiness, data quality controls, and appropriate use of consumer data
  

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

**Technical Expectations**

* A Technical Product Manager owns technical delivery outcomes and understands architecture patterns, application design considerations, data processing concepts, integration points, platform constraints, and application lifecycle practices. This role works directly with engineering to shape, oversee, and deliver sound technical solutions for high-volume, data-driven product platforms.
* Drive application solution ownership for high-volume, data-driven systems and credit risk platforms, including Alternative Data products, FactorTrust capabilities, Blended Scores, and supporting decisioning services by shaping the application design, development approach, testing strategy, implementation plan, operational readiness, and delivery documentation with engineering teams.
* Design or oversee the design and development of data processing solutions, including solution decomposition, application framework considerations, data movement, system integrations, performance, resiliency, debugging, and environment readiness.
* Provide technical direction for Ab Initio-based or similar data processing solutions, including Continuous Flows, application frameworks, performance tuning, debugging, metadata usage, and reusable patterns that can be leveraged by other applications or processes.
* Create and maintain clear documentation that communicates requirements, technical context, decisions, risks, trade-offs, and delivery status for business stakeholders, developers, and senior leaders.
* Identify opportunities to improve tools, processes, services, and system integrations that enable end-user productivity, delivery efficiency, and consistent product execution.
* Collaborate with Data Science and Analytics teams to translate model requirements into scalable production solutions, including score generation workflows, feature engineering requirements, model deployment processes, monitoring frameworks, and performance measurement capabilities.
* Understand credit bureau, alternative data, and blended scoring ecosystems, including data sourcing, consumer reporting requirements, score implementation considerations, model performance monitoring, and client integration patterns.
  

**Leadership Expectations**

* Leads through influence across teams and partner organizations, secures alignment on direction and trade-offs, and operates with sustained
* independence while driving delivery, measurable outcomes, quality documentation, and continuous improvement.
* Influence strategic direction for Alternative Credit and FactorTrust initiatives by aligning business objectives, customer needs, regulatory requirements, data science priorities, and technology investments into a cohesive delivery roadmap.
  

**Qualifications**

* Typically 8+ years of experience in technical product management, application development, engineering, systems analysis, data processing solution delivery, or related product-focused technical roles, including ownership of a product area or program workstream and leadership across multiple delivery teams.
* Demonstrated experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe delivery environments and driving iterative delivery from requirements through development, testing, release, and post-launch adoption.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate and document technical concepts, requirements, risks, decisions, and delivery status for business stakeholders, developers, and senior leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with technical teams on application design, data processing solution development, implementation planning, performance considerations, debugging, operational readiness, and process improvement initiatives.
* Experience with data-driven platforms, application ecosystems, cloud services, integration patterns, or related technical environments.
* Experience delivering data-intensive financial products, credit risk solutions, consumer reporting systems, scorecards, predictive models, or alternative data products.
* Knowledge of FCRA, consumer reporting regulations, permissible purpose requirements, and model governance practices
* Experience in the financial services, insurance, and/or banking industry.
* Bachelor’s degree required.
* Proven ability to work effectively across complex, matrixed environments.
  

**Preferred:**

* Experience with using multiple different alternative data sources in products
* SAFe PO/PM certification, CSPO or related product management certification
* Experience with cloud services in GCP or AWS
* Experience supporting development, deployment, or operationalization of credit scores, risk models, or machine learning solutions
* Experience with Alternative Credit data sources, consumer reporting agencies, lending ecosystems, or financial decisioning platforms
* Experience modernizing legacy credit or financial services platforms and migrating data processing solutions to cloud environments
  

  

**TransUnion Overview:**

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our **Workforce for Good** , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.

  

Be a part of our **Workforce for Good** – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

  
  

TransUnion Job Title

  
  
  
Advisor, Product Management

job_description:
Job ID

71486

Category

Enterprise Technology

Location

Chennai, India

Work Type

On-site

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager with strong hands-on expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Java, and Spring Boot to strengthen the team supporting the LSL integration platform and TMS migration across IMG and EU markets. The role combines product ownership, technical delivery, cloud engineering, application support, and stakeholder collaboration to deliver secure, scalable solutions for finished-vehicle logistics operations.

* Drive product and technical delivery for cloud-based applications supporting finished-vehicle logistics operations.
* Design, develop, test, and maintain Java/Spring Boot microservices and RESTful APIs, with frontend contributions using Angular or React and TypeScript where required.
* Deploy and operate cloud-native applications on GCP, including Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, App Engine, GKE, BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and related services.
* Design and maintain infrastructure as code with Terraform, applying sound principles for scalability, reliability, security, and cost management.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Cloud Build, Jenkins, or equivalent tools, with automated testing and quality/security gates.
* Publish, secure, version, and govern APIs through Apigee, including access control, documentation, and lifecycle management.
* Develop and maintain data products, ETL processes, and transformation rules that support operational and business requirements.
* Write and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and database structures; troubleshoot performance across applications, APIs, and data layers.
* Implement observability through monitoring, logging, alerting, and distributed tracing using services and tools such as Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace, or OpenTelemetry.
* Apply secure software-development practices throughout the SDLC and remediate findings from Fossa, Checkmarx, 42Crunch, SonarQube, and related tools.
* Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, architects, QA, DevOps, security teams, and logistics stakeholders to translate business needs into clear requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Participate in planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, code reviews, and architecture discussions; maintain delivery tracking in Jira or equivalent tools.
* Troubleshoot production issues, coordinate incident resolution, and support reliable application and infrastructure operations.
* Explore practical opportunities to use Python and AI/ML to improve automation, product capabilities, and data insights.
* Create documentation and transfer knowledge to support continuity and backfill activities.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of software development, solution design, testing, and application support experience.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience developing Java applications with Spring Boot and microservices.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating solutions on GCP.
* Experience with GCP data services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub.
* Practical experience with Terraform, GitHub, CI/CD, automated testing, and cloud architecture principles.
* Experience developing, securing, integrating, and consuming RESTful APIs.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, application performance, and data integration patterns.
* Experience with Agile delivery methods and tools such as Jira, ServiceNow
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, organizational, and collaboration skills; able to work independently when required.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* GCP certification, such as Associate Cloud Engineer, Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, or Professional Cloud Architect.
* Experience with AWS or Azure in addition to GCP.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and serverless technologies.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar database platforms.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and cloud security controls.
* Exposure to AI/ML frameworks, applications, or automation use cases.
* Contribution to open-source projects or experience working in distributed engineering teams.

title: Senior Product Manager - US Taxation
job_description:
**About the Job**

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own product or domain-level outcomes for internal products or a complex product area. You will define the near- to mid-term product direction, translate business objectives into outcome-driven roadmaps, and ensure delivery of capabilities that create measurable business value.

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, you will balance tradeoffs across scope, sequencing, value, and delivery constraints, partner closely with senior stakeholders, and drive alignment across cross functional teams within a global delivery model. You will be empowered by our collaborative culture and commitment to excellence to shape the future of our internal products, fostering agility and innovation in a rapidly evolving professional services landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Owning and maintaining Multi quarter product roadmaps for assigned products or a complex product area, aligning to business objectives and user needs
* Defining product direction and outcomes within an established domain strategy, ensuring work is sequenced to maximize value realization
* Leading discovery to understand user workflows, pain points, and opportunities, and translating insights into clear product outcomes
* Making scope, sequencing, and tradeoff decisions to balance value, risk, dependencies, and delivery constraints
* Owning backlog health across initiatives, ensuring epics, features, and stories are clearly articulated, outcome-driven, and delivery-ready
* Partnering with Engineering, Design, Data, Product Operations, and Product Success to deliver high-quality solutions and ensure adoption and value realization
* Identifying and managing product risks, dependencies, and constraints throughout delivery, escalating appropriately and driving mitigation
* Defining success metrics and KPIs, and using product performance data and user feedback to inform prioritization and continuous improvement
* Driving consistency, alignment, and reuse with Product Managers across pods to reduce duplication and scale effective practices
* Mentoring and coaching Product Managers and Associate Product Managers to build product capability and maturity.
* Communicating product strategy, progress, risks, and performance to senior stakeholders with clear rationale and recommendations.
* Staying current with emerging technologies (including AI, automation, and analytics) to identify applicable opportunities within your product area.
* Other duties as assigned Additional Responsibilities for Specialized Product Roles (as applicable) AI & Automation Specialization.
* Owning delivery of AI-enabled or automation capabilities across one or more products or workflows within your product area
* Defining AI use cases, success metrics, and acceptance criteria in partnership with engineering, data, and business stakeholders
* Assessing feasibility, risks, controls, and expected business impact for automation opportunities, and incorporating results into roadmap sequencing
* Ensuring AI- enabled features align with firm standards, governance, and responsible AI guidelines
* Monitoring performance, adoption, and quality of AI-enabled features to drive continuous improvement Data Product Specialization
* Owning delivery of data products or analytics capabilities that enable decision-making and operational workflows within your product area.
* Demonstrating working knowledge of machine learning concepts, including LLMs, NLP techniques, and common model types, sufficient to understand model behavior, limitations, and tradeoffs when defining product requirements and roadmap priorities.
* Partnering closely with Data Team and Data Engineers throughout the model lifecycle, including understanding how models are built, evaluated, deployed, and regression tested, and incorporating model performance and quality considerations into product decisions.
* Defining data requirements, key metrics, and quality expectations in partnership with data and engineering teams.
* Translating business questions into scalable data product initiatives, features, and delivery ready backlog items.
* Prioritizing data initiatives based on business value, dependencies, and data readiness, and sequencing work to support value realization.
* Using analytics and insights to guide product decisions and measure outcomes

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (MBA preferred but not required)
* Proven track record of launching AI products in B2B or enterprise environments, Building and scale AI/ML products
* Use of AI tools for development to prototype
* 8 to12 years of product management experience or closely related experience, preferably ina B2B or professional services environment
* Proven experience owning products or complex product areas end-to-end, from strategy execution through delivery and optimization
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and product management best practices, including roadmap planning and backlog management.
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently in complex, multi-stakeholder environments and influence without direct authority.
* Experience defining success metrics and using data to drive prioritization and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive-ready updates and recommendations.
* Experience working with cross functional teams and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Familiarity with tools such as Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, or similar product management platforms Preferred Experience.
* Professional certifications in one or more domains (Tax / Audit / Advisory / Internal Services).
* Experience supporting adoption and change within an organization to ensure successful rollout of new products or processes.
* Experience with analytics, automation, AI-enabled workflows, or data-driven product capabilities applied to business problems.
* Advanced analytical skills, including experience with data visualization and metrics interpretation.
* Exposure to vendor-supported or outsourced delivery models.
* Ability to travel as needed

* Driving consistency, alignment, and reuse with Product Managers across pods to reduce duplication and scale effective practices
* Mentoring and coaching Product Managers and Associate Product Managers to build product capability and maturity.
* Communicating product strategy, progress, risks, and performance to senior stakeholders with clear rationale and recommendations.
* Staying current with emerging technologies (including AI, automation, and analytics) to identify applicable opportunities within your product area.
* Other duties as assigned Additional Responsibilities for Specialized Product Roles (as applicable) AI & Automation Specialization.
* Owning delivery of AI-enabled or automation capabilities across one or more products or workflows within your product area
* Defining AI use cases, success metrics, and acceptance criteria in partnership with engineering, data, and business stakeholders
* Assessing feasibility, risks, controls, and expected business impact for automation opportunities, and incorporating results into roadmap sequencing
* Ensuring AI- enabled features align with firm standards, governance, and responsible AI guidelines
* Monitoring performance, adoption, and quality of AI-enabled features to drive continuous improvement Data Product Specialization
* Owning delivery of data products or analytics capabilities that enable decision-making and operational workflows within your product area.
* Demonstrating working knowledge of machine learning concepts, including LLMs, NLP techniques, and common model types, sufficient to understand model behavior, limitations, and tradeoffs when defining product requirements and roadmap priorities.
* Partnering closely with Data Team and Data Engineers throughout the model lifecycle, including understanding how models are built, evaluated, deployed, and regression tested, and incorporating model performance and quality considerations into product decisions.
* Defining data requirements, key metrics, and quality expectations in partnership with data and engineering teams.
* Translating business questions into scalable data product initiatives, features, and delivery ready backlog items.
* Prioritizing data initiatives based on business value, dependencies, and data readiness, and sequencing work to support value realization.
* Using analytics and insights to guide product decisions and measure outcomes

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (MBA preferred but not required)
* Proven track record of launching AI products in B2B or enterprise environments, Building and scale AI/ML products
* Use of AI tools for development to prototype
* 8 to12 years of product management experience or closely related experience, preferably ina B2B or professional services environment
* Proven experience owning products or complex product areas end-to-end, from strategy execution through delivery and optimization
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and product management best practices, including roadmap planning and backlog management.
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently in complex, multi-stakeholder environments and influence without direct authority.
* Experience defining success metrics and using data to drive prioritization and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive-ready updates and recommendations.
* Experience working with cross functional teams and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Familiarity with tools such as Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, or similar product management platforms Preferred Experience.
* Professional certifications in one or more domains (Tax / Audit / Advisory / Internal Services).
* Experience supporting adoption and change within an organization to ensure successful rollout of new products or processes.
* Experience with analytics, automation, AI-enabled workflows, or data-driven product capabilities applied to business problems.
* Advanced analytical skills, including experience with data visualization and metrics interpretation.
* Exposure to vendor-supported or outsourced delivery models.
* Ability to travel as needed
